blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Computer use has reached a turning point: the focus is expanding from GUI-only interaction to systems that complete tasks on users' computers through visual and programmatic interfaces. We define a generalist computer-use agent (GCUA) as a system in which the model chooses how to observe, act, and organize its work across visual and programmatic interfaces. Yet frontier implementations, such as GPT-6 Astra's computer-use system, remain largely closed, limiting systematic study of their design. We introduce Open Generalist CUA (OpenGCUA), an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for GCUAs with the community. This report presents the first release of OpenGCUA. Code execution is a key feature of our agent design: it lets intermediate results determine subsequent operations and enables models to apply their existing programming capabilities directly to computer interaction. We also propose harness-to-model decision transfer, moving selected observations and task-state decisions from fixed harness rules to the model. On OSWorld-v2, our full configuration improves task scores across all eight evaluated models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5, raising mean partial score by +19.6 points and reducing reported steps per task by an average of 53.0% relative to batched GUI-only execution. We release our implementation and prompts, evaluation trajectories from all eight models, and preliminary versions of a real-device harness and a cross-device SDK. The harness addresses real-device challenges not fully captured by benchmarks, while the SDK provides a common programming interface across computers, mobiles and browsers. Across four real macOS tasks under our real-device harness, selected Qwen3.8-Max runs use 19.4 times as many reported reasoning tokens as GPT-6 Astra, highlighting substantial differences between models in real-device execution efficiency.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Computer use has moved to the center of attention. The GPT-6 Astra release places strong emphasis on computer use, with extensive demonstrations offering an exciting vision of what computer-use agents could make possible ( OpenAI, 2026c ) .
Much of the literature studies computer-use agents (CUAs) as GUI-only agents, asking how well models can complete computer tasks through screenshot-based observation and mouse and keyboard actions ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) .
Recent frontier systems, however, combine GUI interaction with shell commands, accessibility-tree access, and other tools, and OpenAI now recommends code execution, writing GUI operations as code and combining them with programmatic operations in a single model output ( OpenAI, 2026b ) .
These systems also target tasks on users’ own computers, where shared control, interaction with background windows, and evolving requests introduce challenges not fully captured by benchmarks.
The question has changed, from how well a model operates a GUI interface to how well a system completes work on a real computer by whatever means works. We take this as a turning point in computer-use research, motivating a clearer definition of these broader agents and a systematic study of their design.

blocks.en:
We therefore adopt the term generalist computer-use agent (GCUA) to characterize this broader class of systems, following the system-level perspective of Agents’ Last Exam ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . GPT-6 Astra’s computer-use system is a representative GCUA. We define a GCUA as an agent system designed to complete diverse computer tasks through both visual interaction and programmatic access, in which the model decides how to observe, act, and organize its work as the task requires . Programmatic access includes shell commands, accessibility APIs, and application or service APIs where available.
Essentially, a GCUA chooses how to use the computer to complete a task, rather than being restricted to GUI interaction. Our previous work, Qwen-UI-Agent, began exploring this direction through a unified GUI and CLI action space with batched actions ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Within our formulation, such GUI+CLI hybrid CUA is a special case of GCUA (Section 2 ).

blocks.en:
How to design such systems is an open question.
A GCUA raises design questions that go beyond those of GUI-only agents: which interfaces to give the model, how to support code execution, which decisions to leave to the model and which to the harness, and what changes when the agent runs on a user’s own computer.
However, frontier systems such as GPT-6 Astra remain largely closed ( OpenAI, 2026a ) .
Their model weights, full prompting setups, real-device harnesses, device-control SDKs, and execution trajectories are not available.
This limits the community’s ability to reproduce system behavior, compare alternative designs, and investigate how design choices and execution mechanisms affect task completion and cost, particularly under real-device conditions.

blocks.en: We therefore introduce Open Generalist CUA (OpenGCUA), an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for generalist computer use with the community (Figure 2 ): (1) Model. Develop a model that unifies computer and browser use, with code execution and harness-to-model decision transfer central to its agent design. (2) System. A real-device harness that runs on users’ real machines, and lessons we learned in moving from benchmark harnesses to real-device deployment. A cross-device SDK that gives agent programs one interface to computers, browsers, and phones, supporting tasks that span multiple devices. (3) Trajectories. Release trajectories from evaluations of frontier models such as GPT-6 Astra to support analysis of code-execution and harness-to-model decision transfer patterns. (4) Efficiency. Systematically study and improve GCUA execution efficiency through code-execution, concise model reasoning, and harness optimization, while exploring broader system-level improvements. (5) Evaluation. Develop evaluation environments and benchmarks on real devices, particularly on macOS, to assess agents’ ability to complete tasks under real-world operating conditions.

blocks.en:
This report presents the first release of the OpenGCUA project. The release does not yet include a trained model. The report covers agent design and evaluation, execution trajectories from frontier models, and preliminary versions of the real-device harness and cross-device SDK, together with a roadmap for subsequent releases. Our main contributions are as follows. • GCUA generalizes existing GUI, CLI, and hybrid agents. We define a GCUA by three decisions that its model makes at each step: what to observe, how to act, and how to organize its work. We show that GUI agents, CLI agents, multi-agent hybrids, and GUI+CLI agents such as Qwen-UI-Agent each fix some of these decisions in advance, and are special cases of GCUA (Section 2 ). • GCUA outperforms GUI-only CUA on every frontier model we test. We implement our GCUA agent design into the OpenGCUA harness, which lets existing models use code execution and harness-to-model decision transfer. We test it with eight frontier models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5. On the offline set of OSWorld-v2, the full GCUA setting raises the mean partial score by 19.6 points , cuts steps per task by 53.0% , and narrows the score gap between the strongest and weakest models by more than half. We release the implementation, prompts, and evaluation trajectories of all eight frontier models (Section 3 ). • Code execution adds value beyond shell access. With the same GUI and shell access, writing GUI operations as code and combining them with programmatic operations adds 6.1 points to the mean partial score and cuts steps per task by 14.8% against the GUI+CLI baseline.
Code execution offers two advantages: intermediate results can decide the next operation without another model call, and models can bring their existing programming ability directly to computer interaction. We further identify five recurring patterns of code execution in our case study (Section 3.1 ). • Harness control should move into the model as models improve. Harnesses fix many workflow decisions by rule, such as taking a screenshot after every step. We propose harness-to-model decision transfer , which delegates these harness decisions to the model. In the current implementation, the model decides when to request screenshots and how to track task state. It also states each program’s purpose before execution. On-demand observation alone increases cache hit rates by 10.5 and 14.4 percentage points for two models without lowering task scores (Section 3.2 ). • On real devices, a large gap lies in the model. We release a preliminary real-device harness for users’ own computers, addressing challenges unseen in benchmarks, such as sharing the machine with its user and acting on background windows. With the harness held fixed, Qwen3.8-Max uses 19.4 times as many reasoning tokens as GPT-6 Astra on four real macOS tasks, and 5.7 times as many output tokens in total. Case studies trace this gap to model behavior: large reasoning cost for simple operations, difficulty adapting to real-device conditions and a gap in code execution capability (Section 4 ). • One Programming Interface for Computers, Browsers, and Phones. The preliminary Cross-Device SDK binds every operation to an explicit device, application, window, or tab, keeps accessibility and vision as separate ways to observe and act, and allows one program to coordinate several devices within a task (Section 4.2 ).

blocks.en: 2 Generalist CUA: Definition and Positioning
blocks.zh: 2 通用分类法:定义和定位

blocks.en: 2.1 Definition
blocks.zh: 2.1 定义

blocks.en:
Agents’ Last Exam takes a system-level view and decomposes an agent into five layers: the model (Brain), GUI perception (Eyes), orchestration (Body), tools (Hands), and a runtime (Feet) ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . Under this view, a CLI agent lacks GUI perception, a GUI agent lacks most of the remaining layers, and a generalist agent spans all five.
Having all five layers, however, only means an agent can act through both the GUI and the CLI; it does not mean that the agent chooses well between them.
At a given step, an agent may click through a dozen screens to do what a single shell command would do, or run a script when it first needs to look at the screen. The layer view cannot tell such an agent apart from one that picks the right way to act at each step.
In this report, we therefore define a generalist CUA (GCUA) by the decisions it makes at each step, not by the components it contains .
blocks.zh:
Agents ' Last Expomm 的系统级视图,将一个代理分解为五层:模型(Brain),GUI感知(Eyes),管弦(Body),工具(Hands),以及运行时间(Feet)(Sun等,2026年). 在这种观点下,一个CLI代理缺乏GUI感知,一个GUI代理缺少所剩多层,一个通论代理跨越了所有五个.
然而,拥有所有五个层,只意味着一个代理可以同时通过GUI和CLI来行动;这并不意味着代理在它们之间作出很好的选择.
在特定的步骤下,一个代理可能会点击一打屏幕来做单个 shell 命令会做的事,或者在它第一次需要查看屏幕时运行一个脚本. 层视图不能告诉这样的代理人,除了选择正确的方式在每一个步骤上采取行动。
因此,在本报告中,我们通过每一步骤的决定,而不是其中包含的构成部分,来界定一个笼统的CUA(GCUA)。

blocks.en: A GCUA makes three decisions at each step: what to observe, how to act, and how to organize. • What to Observe. The observation can be a screenshot, an accessibility tree (AX Tree), the output of a command, the response of an API, or any combination of these. The model decides which it needs, including whether it needs a new screenshot at all. • How to Act. The action can be a GUI operation at a screen coordinate, an operation on an accessibility element, a shell command, an API call, or a program that combines several of these. The model decides which fits the step. • How to Organize. Across steps, the agent keeps a plan, tracks what has been done, and decides which past observations stay in context. Most harnesses fix these as rules set by the developer. In a GCUA, the model makes these decisions as the task requires.
blocks.zh: • 全球协调会每一步作出三项决定:观察什么、如何行动、如何组织。 何以观察. 观测可以是截图,无障碍树(AX Tree),命令的输出,API的响应,或者这些的任意组合. 该模型决定它需要什么,包括它是否需要一个新的截图。 如何行动. 动作可以是屏幕坐标下的GUI操作,在可访问元素上的操作, shell命令,API呼叫,或者将其中几个组合在一起的程序. · 模式决定哪种步骤适合。 如何组织. 在整个步骤中,代理人保持一个计划,跟踪已经做的工作,并决定过去哪些观察与背景一致。 大部分的取用器固定这些作为开发者设定的规则. 在《全球协调法》中,模式根据任务要求作出这些决定。

blocks.en: The first two decisions range over four interfaces to the computer, and each offers both a way to observe and a way to act. • GUI. The agent sees a screenshot and clicks, drags, scrolls, or types at a screen coordinate. This is the interface that always works, since every application has pixels. • Accessibility Tree. The agent reads the elements of a window, with their roles, names, and values, and operates on an element directly. It needs no coordinate, does not bring the window to the front, and never moves the user’s pointer on real devices. • CLI. The agent runs shell commands and reads their output. This is the natural route for files, data, and software. • API. The agent calls external services, such as web search, and reads their responses. This reaches what neither the screen nor the shell can.
blocks.zh: 前两项决定涉及计算机的四个接口,每个接口都提供了一种观察方式和一种行动方式。 代理机在屏幕坐标处看到截图并点击,拖动,滚动,或键入. 这是总是有效的接口,因为每个应用程序都有像素. • 无障碍树。 代理读取窗口的元素,包含其角色,名称和值,并直接在元素上运行. 它不需要任何坐标, 也不会将窗口带到前面, 也不会在真实设备上移动用户的指针 。 • CLI。 代理运行 shell 命令并读取其输出 。 这是文件、数据和软件的自然路线。 • API。 代理机呼叫外部服务,如网络搜索,并读取他们的回复. 这是屏幕和外壳都达不到的

blocks.en:
Putting these together yields the definition used throughout the report: A GCUA is an agent system designed to complete diverse computer tasks through both visual interaction and programmatic access, in which the model decides how to observe, act, and organize its work as the task requires .
This definition refines that of ALE rather than replacing it. Visual interaction and programmatic access require all five layers, and our definition further asks who makes the decisions within them.
blocks.zh:
将这些因素合并在一起,就形成了整个报告所使用的定义: GCUA是一个代理系统,旨在通过视觉互动和程序访问来完成多种多样的计算机任务,其中模型决定如何观察、采取行动和按照任务要求安排工作。
这个定义完善了ALE的定义,而不是取而代之. 视觉互动和方案准入需要所有五个层面,我们的定义还询问由谁在这些层面作出决定。

blocks.en:
Our recent GUI+CLI agent, Qwen-UI-Agent ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , released shortly before GPT-6 Astra, is an instructive special case of Eq. ( 1 ). It places GUI and CLI actions in one action space and lets the model emit a batch of several actions in one call. In our notation, it fixes q t ≡ { screenshot } , p t = ( a 1 , … , a n ) , a i ∈ 𝒜 GUI ∪ 𝒜 CLI , m t + 1 = h ⁡ ( m t , o t ) , q_{t}\equiv\{\text{screenshot}\},\qquad p_{t}=(a_{1},\dots,a_{n}),\ a_{i}\in\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{GUI}}\cup\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{CLI}},\qquad m_{t+1}=h(m_{t},o_{t}), (3) where h h is a fixed harness rule, such as keeping the last k k screenshots. The model already chooses, action by action, whether to click or to run a command, and this alone improved both success and efficiency over GUI-only execution.
GCUA lifts each of these three constraints. Where the GUI+CLI agent emits a fixed sequence ( a 1 , … , a n ) (a_{1},\dots,a_{n}) , a GCUA writes a program over the full set 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , which adds accessibility and API operations as well as loops, branches, and variables. Inside such a program, a click, an accessibility operation, a shell command, and an API call are simply four kinds of statements. Where the GUI+CLI agent receives a screenshot after every step, a GCUA decides which views to request, including none at all. And where the GUI+CLI agent follows the harness rule h h , a GCUA decides for itself what to keep in its working state.
In our formulation, batched GUI+CLI hybrid agents are a restricted case of GCUA.

blocks.en: 2.2 Relation to Existing Agents
blocks.zh: 2.2 与现有机构的关系

blocks.en: The formalization in Eq. ( 1 ) also lets us compare GCUA with existing agents. Each existing family can be written in the same form, except that some of the three decisions (what to observe, how to act, and how to organize) are fixed in advance instead of being made by the model at each step. Table 1 lists what each family fixes, and the paragraphs below discuss each family in turn.

It always observes a screenshot, so q t ≡ { screenshot } q_{t}\equiv\{\text{screenshot}\} . It acts through one GUI operation per step, so p t p_{t} is a single primitive in 𝒜 GUI \mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{GUI}} . Its working state follows a harness rule m t + 1 = h ⁡ ( m t , o t ) m_{t+1}=h(m_{t},o_{t}) , such as keeping the last k k screenshots. The model still chooses where to click, but not what to observe, which interface to use, or what to keep.

blocks.en: A CLI agent fixes what it observes and restricts how it acts. It has no view of the screen, so q t ≡ ∅ q_{t}\equiv\emptyset and it sees only the execution output e t e_{t} . It acts only through the shell, so p t p_{t} is a program over 𝒜 CLI \mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{CLI}} . It is more flexible than a GUI agent. Its commands and scripts can use loops, branches, and variables. Recent coding agents also let the model decide part of how it organizes its work, for example by summarizing earlier context when it grows long ( Anthropic, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2025 ) . What a CLI agent cannot do is operate an application that can only be used through its graphical interface. Agent frameworks such as OpenClaw support more than the shell, but they also come without built-in GUI control ( Sun et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: Some recent systems combine GUI and programmatic control by dividing the work among several agents. For example, an orchestrator splits a task into subtasks and sends each one to either a GUI operator or a programmer ( Song et al., 2026 ) . Each sub-agent has its own fixed interface. The GUI operator sees screenshots and acts through GUI operations, and the programmer writes and runs code. In terms of Eq. ( 1 ), while sub-agent k k handles a subtask, q t q_{t} and p t p_{t} are limited to its own sets 𝒬 k \mathcal{Q}_{k} and 𝒜 k \mathcal{A}_{k} . Together, the sub-agents cover the same interfaces as a GCUA. The difference is where the choice of interface is made. In these systems, the orchestrator makes it once per subtask. In a GCUA, a single model makes it at every step, and one program can combine several interfaces.

blocks.en: 2.3 Why Now: The Route Flip to Code Execution
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 为什么现在: 路线翻转到代码执行

blocks.en:
In 2026, the frontier began to shift from clicking toward programming, and the shift is visible in vendor documentation rather than only in benchmark scores.
With the release of GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI’s computer-use guide began recommending that models write and run short programs, for example with PyAutoGUI or Playwright, rather than rely primarily on the earlier computer tool for mouse and keyboard actions ( OpenAI, 2026b ) . The guide’s examples reflect this shift: the computer tool still targets the previous model (i.e., GPT-5.6 Sol), while code-execution examples use GPT-6 Astra. A similar pattern appears on OSWorld-v2, where frontier agents perform more actions through code, APIs, and file operations rather than clicks ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) .
OpenAI also reports that GPT-6 Astra completes OSWorld 2.0 tasks in about 47% less time than GPT-5.6 Sol and is 1.9 × \times faster on Mind2Web ( OpenAI, 2026c ) .
OpenAI does not say how much of this gain comes from code execution, but it is the kind of gain one would expect when each model call does more work.
blocks.zh:
2026年,前沿开始从点击转向编程,这一转变可见于供应商文件,而不只是基准分数.
随着GPT-6 Astra的发布,OpenAI的计算机使用指南开始建议模型编写并运行短程序,比如PyAutoGUI或Playwright,而不是主要依靠早期的计算机工具来进行鼠标和键盘动作(OpenAI,2026b. ). 该指南的例子反映了这种转变:计算机工具仍然针对上一个模型(即GPT-5.6 Sol),而代码执行实例则使用GPT-6 Astra. OSWorld-v2上出现了类似的模式,边疆代理通过代码,API,和文件操作来进行更多的动作,而不是点击(Yuan等,2026年).
OpenAI还报道了GPT-6 Astra在比GPT-5.6相较约47%的时间里完成OSWorld 2.0任务,并在Mind2Web(OpenAI, 2026c)上速度快了1.9×\时间. 。 。 。 。
OpenAI没有说这种收益的多少来自代码执行,但是当每个模型调用做更多的工作时,它是人们所期望的这种收益.

blocks.en: Code Execution versus Batched Actions. With batched actions, each model call yields a list of actions that were fixed when the call was generated: the model must decide every click before it sees the result of the first one. With code execution, each model call yields a program, and control flow is decided while the program runs. Three things become possible in a single call that were impossible before: a condition ( if the dialog is visible, dismiss it ), a loop ( for each row, fill the three fields ), and a verification ( assert the status now reads Saved ). A task that took a dozen round trips becomes one. This is also why batched actions, which our earlier work introduced ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , are a stepping stone rather than an endpoint: a batch is a program without control flow.
blocks.zh: 代码执行与扣子动作。 通过分批动作,每个模型调用都会产生一个在生成调用时固定的动作列表:在看到第一个调用的结果之前,模型必须决定每次点击. 通过代码执行,每个模型调用产生一个程序,在程序运行时决定控制流. 在之前不可能的一次呼叫中,有三件事成为可能:一个条件(如果对话框可见,将其删除),一个循环(对于每行,填充三个字段),以及一个核实(申明现在读取Saved的状态). 一项需要十几次往返的任务变成了一项任务。 这也是为什么我们之前的工作(周等,2026年)提出的分批行动是一个踏板而不是终点:分批行动是一个没有控制流的程序.

blocks.en: 2.4 Efficiency as a First-Class Metric
blocks.zh: 2.4 效率作为第一级计量

blocks.en:
Success rate remains our primary measure, but it does not capture the resources required to complete a task.
For interactive tasks, an important threshold is reached when delegation delivers results sooner than manual execution, potentially saving both human effort and time to completion.
We therefore evaluate efficiency using four metrics: steps per task, output tokens, reasoning tokens, and cost.
blocks.zh:
成功率仍然是我们的首要衡量标准,但它没有掌握完成任务所需的资源。
就互动任务而言,当授权比人工执行更早交付成果时,就达到了一个重要的门槛,这有可能节省人力和完成时间。
因此,我们使用四个衡量标准评估效率:每项任务的步骤、产出符号、推理符号和成本。

blocks.en:
Each step is one model call, which may generate multiple actions through batching or code execution.
Fewer steps reduce model-call overhead, while fewer output tokens can lower generation time and cost.
Reasoning tokens are included in output tokens but reported separately.
When reasoning accounts for a large share of output, reducing unnecessary reasoning can improve efficiency without shortening the executable code, provided task performance is maintained.
We compute cost from input and output token usage at each model’s published prices, including cache discounts.
blocks.zh:
每个步骤都是一个模式调用,它可能通过分批或代码执行产生多个动作.
步骤较少会减少模式调用间接费用,而产出符号较少会降低生成时间和成本.
说明理由的符号列入产出符号,但单独报告。
当推理占了产出的很大份额时,如果任务性能得以维持,减少不必要的推理可以提高效率而不会缩短可执行代码.
我们按每个模型公布的价格计算输入和输出符号使用的成本,包括缓存折扣。

blocks.en: 3 Agent Design: Code Execution and Harness-to-Model Decision Transfer
blocks.zh: 3 代理设计:代码执行和对模式的决定转移

blocks.en: This section studies two behaviors we aim to develop in GCUA models. The first is code execution , which concerns how to act: the model combines graphical interaction and programmatic operations within a single program. The second is harness-to-model decision transfer , which concerns what to observe and how to organize: the model makes selected workflow control decisions that a harness would otherwise fix with rules, such as when to look at the screen and how to organize task state. This release does not introduce a trained model. Instead, we study how the prompts, tool interfaces, and execution runtime of Open Generalist CUA support these behaviors in existing frontier models. We first explain the design and illustrate it with execution trajectories, then evaluate its effects on task completion and cost.
blocks.zh: 本节研究了我们打算在GCUA模型中发展的两个行为. 第一个是代码执行,它涉及如何行动:模型将图形交互与程序操作结合在一个单一程序内. 第二是“牵引式”决策转移,它涉及观察什么和如何组织:该模型作出选定的工作流程控制决定,否则,牵引式将固定规则,例如何时看屏幕以及如何组织任务状态。 这一发布没有引入训练有素的模型. 相反,我们研究Open Generalist CUA的提示、工具界面和执行运行时间如何支持现有前沿模型中的这些行为。 我们首先解释设计并用执行轨迹加以说明,然后评价其对任务完成和成本的影响。

blocks.en: 3.1 Code Execution over GUI and CLI
blocks.zh: 3.1 在图形界面和CLI上执行代码

blocks.en: Code execution gives graphical interaction and programmatic operations a unified executable form. The model writes a program in which GUI actions, such as pyautogui.click() , can be combined with shell commands and Python computation. The model can therefore specify not only what operations to perform, but also how execution should proceed. Loops and conditional logic allow the program to repeat operations and choose subsequent actions based on intermediate results, without requiring a new model call for each operation. On OSWorld-v2, this design improves Qwen3.8-Max’s mean task score by 5.2 points and reduces steps per task by 17.0% relative to a hybrid CUA baseline with batched GUI+CLI actions (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 代码执行使图形交互和程序操作具有统一的可执行形式. 该模型会写一个程序,其中GUI动作,如pyautogui.click (),可以与 shell 命令和 Python 计算相结合. 因此,该模型不仅可以规定要执行什么业务,而且可以规定如何执行。 循环和有条件的逻辑允许程序重复操作并选择基于中间结果的后继动作,而不需要每个操作需要新的模型调用. 在OSWorld-v2上,这个设计将Qune3.8-Max的平均任务分数提高了5.2分,并且相对于混合CUA基线和分批的GUI+CLI动作(第3.3节),将每个任务的步数减少了17.0%.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Implementation

Prompt Design. The system prompt specifies the programming interfaces and output format for code execution. The OSWorld-v2 configuration specifies PyAutoGUI for desktop interaction and the Python function bash() for executing shell commands.
The prompt for the real-device harness additionally describes Playwright for browser interaction. The prompt requires one Python program in a <code> block per step and includes examples that combine interface operations, shell commands, and checks on intermediate results. The full prompt is given in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
即时设计. 系统提示器指定了代码执行的编程接口和输出格式. OSWorld-v2配置指定了用于桌面交互的PyAutoGUI,用于执行 shell命令的Python函数shash ().
real-device的调用提示额外描述了Playwright用于浏览器交互. 提示需要在每步的 < code> 块中有一个 Python 程序,并包括将界面操作, shell 命令,以及检查中间结果结合起来的例子. 附录C提供了全部提示。

blocks.en:
Program Execution. The harness extracts and syntax-checks the code block, then executes it in the computer environment. The runtime supports desktop interaction through PyAutoGUI and, in the real-device harness, browser interaction through Playwright.
Shell commands execute through bash() , which returns command output and exit status. The Python control flow coordinates these calls, allowing loops and conditions to combine GUI and shell operations within one program.
blocks.zh:
程序执行。 取出和语法检查代码块,然后在计算机环境中执行. 运行时间通过PyAutoGUI支持桌面交互,在真设备的取用中,通过Playwright支持浏览器交互.
shell 命令通过 bash( ) 执行, 它返回命令输出和退出状态 。 Python控制流协调这些调用,允许循环和条件在一个程序内将GUI和 shell操作结合起来.

blocks.en:
Execution Feedback. The harness returns captured standard output, standard error, and execution status to the model. With on-demand observation enabled, observations include a new screenshot when the program requests one through the screenshot() action. The real-device harness additionally returns accessibility-tree observations when requested by the model.
We have open-sourced both the preliminary real-device harness and the code execution harness.
blocks.zh:
执行反馈。 牵引器返回了捕获到的标准输出,标准出错,以及模型的执行状态. 启用点播观察后, 当程序通过截图动作请求时, 观察会包含一个新的截图 。 真实设备在模型要求时会额外返回可访问性-树木观测。
我们已经开源了 初步真正的设备 和代码执行设备。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Representative Code-Execution Patterns
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 代号-执行模式

blocks.en:
The implementation specifies what a program can contain, but we want to see how models actually write programs to solve concrete tasks.
We therefore examine GPT-6 Astra on OSWorld-v2, and find five recurring patterns in how its programs connect actions, intermediate results, and model observations. The examples illustrate complementary uses of code, rather than mutually exclusive categories or isolated performance gains.
blocks.zh:
执行中指定了一个程序可以包含什么,但我们想看看模型如何实际写入程序来解决具体的任务.
因此,我们研究了OSWorld-v2上的GPT-6 Astra,并发现其方案如何将行动、中间结果和模型观测联系起来的五个反复出现模式。 这些例子说明了守则的补充用途,而不是相互排斥的类别或孤立的绩效收益。

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Programs coordinate actions and checks. (a) GUI clicks alternate with checks of generated contracts and local drafts.
(b) A loop visits seven webpage sections and checks each active section through the DOM.
(c) A draft comparison determines whether to click Send, without verifying delivery.
blocks.zh:
图3:方案协调行动和检查。 (a) 图形用户界面在检查生成的合同和当地草稿时另起炉灶。
(b) 循环访问7个网页部分,并通过DOM检查每个活动部分。
(c) 比较草案确定是否在不核实交货的情况下点击Send。

blocks.en:
Figure 4: Programs prepare and verify evidence. (a) A program assembles 25 views into a contact sheet for the model’s next observation.
(b) Assertions check background images and transparency, and verify that non-background content remains unchanged.
blocks.zh:
图 4: 方案编制和核实证据。 (a) 一个程序将25个观点汇集成一个联系表,供模型下一次观察。
(b) 请求检查背景图像和透明度,并核实非背景内容保持不变。

blocks.en:
Cross-Interface Composition. A single program can use information from one interface to guide operations through another.
A program can alternate between GUI actions and programmatic checks within one model step. In a contract-generation task, the agent clicks a spreadsheet button, reads the application’s completion status, and checks the output files. Only after these checks pass does it click a second button to create local email drafts, which it then inspects programmatically. This example connects GUI execution with structured feedback from both the application and its files (Figure 3 a).
blocks.zh:
交叉组成. 单个程序可以使用一个接口的信息来引导操作通过另一个接口.
一个程序可以在一个模式步骤内在图形用户界面的行动和方案检查之间取而代之. 在合同生成任务中,代理点击电子表格按钮,读取应用程序的完成状态,并检查输出文件. 只有在这些检查通过后,它才会点击第二个按钮来创建本地电子邮件草稿,然后在程序上检查这些草稿。 此示例将GUI执行与应用程序及其文件的结构化反馈相连接(图3 a).

blocks.en:
Loop-Based Execution. Loops let the model specify a procedure once and repeat it across multiple targets within one program. Unlike a fixed action list, the targets and number of iterations can be determined during execution, for example from file contents or application state. This allows repeated work to proceed without generating a separate action sequence or making a new model call for each iteration.
To record a website walkthrough, the agent iterates over seven navigation targets, clicks each target, and reads the active section from the DOM. An assertion checks that the resulting section matches the intended target before the loop continues. The program handles all seven visits and checks without returning to the model between iterations (Figure 3 b).
blocks.zh:
循环执行。 循环让模型指定一个程序一次,并在一个程序中跨多个目标重复. 与固定的动作列表不同,重复的对象和数量可以在执行过程中确定,例如从文件内容或应用程序状态中确定. 这使得重复的工作得以进行,而无需生成单独的动作序列或对每次迭代发出新的模型呼吁.
为了记录一个网站行走,代理在7个导航目标上移动,点击每个目标,从DOM读取活动部分. 进行断言检查,在循环继续之前,结果的一节与预定目标相符。 程序处理所有7次访问和检查,而不返回迭代之间的模型(图3b).

blocks.en: Result-Dependent Execution. Conditional logic lets the program respond to what happens during execution. It can inspect command output or application state, check a result, and decide whether to continue. Such decisions can remain within the program when their conditions are computable, rather than requiring the model to interpret each intermediate result. A local check can determine whether a GUI action should proceed. Before sending an email reply, the agent copies the draft from the interface and compares it with a saved version after trimming leading and trailing whitespace. Its program clicks Send only if the texts match and reports a mismatch otherwise. The recorded execution follows the matching branch, but delivery is not verified within this step (Figure 3 c).
blocks.zh: 结果-依存执行。 有条件的逻辑让程序响应执行期间发生的事情. 它可以检查命令输出或应用程序状态,检查结果,并决定是否继续. 当这些决定的条件可以计算时,而不是要求模型解释每个中间结果时,这些决定可以留在方案内. 本地检查可以确定是否应该进行GUI行动 。 在发送电子邮件回复前,代理从界面复制了草稿,并比作被保存的版本,经过修剪后引导并跟踪白空间. 其程序仅在文本匹配并报告不匹配时点击发送。 所记录的执行跟随了匹配分支,但此步骤内没有核实交付(图3c).

blocks.en: Observation Preparation. Programs can gather and organize evidence for the next model decision. They can collect multiple views, crop relevant regions, or arrange images into a visual summary. This extends code execution from performing actions to preparing observations that the model can then interpret. While inspecting a three-dimensional object, the agent collects 25 views, crops the relevant region from each, and assembles a numbered contact sheet. It opens this sheet and requests one new visual observation. The program collects and arranges views for the model’s visual judgment (Figure 4 a).
blocks.zh: 观察准备. 方案可以为下一个示范决定收集和组织证据。 它们可以收集多种视图,收割相关区域,或者将图像排列成可视摘要. 这将代码执行从执行动作延伸到准备模型随后可以解释的观察. 在检查一三维物体时,物剂从每个区域收集了25个视图,收割了相关区域,并组装了编号的联系表. 它打开这个工作表,要求一个新的视觉观察. 该程序为模型的视觉判断收集和安排了视图(图4 a).

blocks.en: Executable Verification. Programs can check both intended changes and content that should remain unchanged. After editing two slide backgrounds, the agent compares the original and saved presentation packages. It checks the expected changes, verifies that the other 64 original package entries are unchanged, and compares slide content outside the background elements. These assertions make selected preservation requirements explicit, but do not replace independent evaluation (Figure 4 b).
blocks.zh: 可执行核查。 程序可以检查预期的修改和内容,这些修改和内容应保持不变。 在编辑了两个幻灯片背景后,代理商比较了原始演示文稿包并保存了演示文稿包. 它检查预期的变化,核实其他64个原始软件包条目没有变化,并比较了背景元素以外的幻灯片内容. 这些断言明确了选定的保全要求,但并不取代独立评价(图4b)。

blocks.en: These examples show a useful division of work: programs execute locally specified operations and checks, while the model chooses the procedure and interprets evidence that still requires judgment.
blocks.zh: 这些例子显示了一个有用的分工:程序执行本地指定的操作和检查,而模型选择程序并解释仍然需要判断的证据.

blocks.en: 3.1.3 Limits of Visual-Only Feedback
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 仅视觉反馈的限制

blocks.en: Result-dependent control is harder when interface observations are limited to screenshots. Conditions such as whether a button is enabled or an input field contains the expected value are not directly exposed as program-readable values, so checking them may require another model call. Accessibility trees can expose text and control states as structured data, allowing programs to query supported interface properties and use them in loops and conditional logic. This motivates combining visual observation with accessibility-tree access in our real-device harness design.
blocks.zh: 当界面观察仅限于截图时,依赖结果的控制更难. 诸如是否启用了按钮或输入字段包含预期值等条件不作为程序可读值直接被曝光,因此检查这些条件可能需要再作模型调用. 可访问树可以将文本状态和控制状态暴露为结构化数据,允许程序查询所支持的界面属性,并在循环和条件逻辑中使用. 这促使我们把视觉观察与无障碍-树木连接结合到我们的真设备带设计中。

blocks.en: 3.2 Harness-to-Model Decision Transfer
blocks.zh: 3.2 对模式的决定转让

blocks.en: Code execution addresses how to act by allowing the model to express computer operations as programs. A GCUA must also decide what to observe and how to organize its work. We study harness-to-model decision transfer : replacing selected fixed harness rules with task-dependent model decisions. A screenshot, for example, may be necessary after a GUI action but redundant when program output already answers the relevant question. Deciding whether to request it should depend on the information needed to continue.
blocks.zh: 代码执行涉及如何通过允许模型将计算机操作表现为程序来行动. GCUA还必须决定观察什么以及如何安排其工作。 我们研究“牵引式”决策转移:用依赖任务的示范决定取代选定的固定牵引规则。 例如,在GUI行动之后,可能还需要一个截图,但在程序输出已经回答相关问题时则需要冗余. 决定是否要求它取决于继续需要的信息。

blocks.en: Mechanism in the Harness, Decision in the Model. As models become more capable, we envision progressively shifting selected workflow decisions from fixed harness rules to the model. The harness should provide reliable mechanisms, while the model decides when and how to use them based on the task and available evidence. In the current implementation, screenshot requests and task-state updates are model-initiated workflow operations, complemented by model-generated action-intent annotations. The harness continues to execute interface calls, preserve task records, and manage context retention.
blocks.zh: 利用机制,模式中的决定。 随着模型的能力增强,我们设想逐步将选定的工作流程决定从固定规则转移到模型。 利用应提供可靠的机制,而模型则根据任务和现有证据决定何时以及如何使用这些机制。 在目前的执行中,截图请求和任务状态更新是模型启动的工作流程操作,并辅之以模型生成的动作提示. 该取用继续执行接口呼叫,保存任务记录并管理上下文保留.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Mechanisms for Harness-to-Model Decision Transfer
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 决策移交机制

blocks.en: On-Demand Observation. The screenshot function lets the model decide whether its next input needs a new screenshot. It can request visual feedback after a GUI action or continue without it when text output is sufficient. On-demand observation can reduce context length by omitting screenshots that add little information. The environment still captures a screenshot after every step, so the mechanism changes what the model receives, not what the environment records.
blocks.zh: 临行观察. 截图功能让模型决定其下个输入是否需要一个新的截图. 它可以在GUI动作后请求视觉反馈,也可以在文本输出足够时在没有图像反馈的情况下继续. 点播观察可以通过省略添加了很少信息的截图来缩短上下文长度. 环境仍然能捕捉出每一步后的一个截图,因此机制会改变模型得到的,而不是环境记录的.

blocks.en:
Task-State Tracking. The todo interface lets the model maintain a persistent record of progress, facts, and unresolved questions. It updates this record through todo.update() and retrieves it through todo.list() .
Statuses distinguish pending work, attempted changes, unverified changes, and claimed verification, helping the model track what still needs checking. These entries record the model’s assessment rather than independently verifying the environment.
blocks.zh:
任务状态追踪。 待办事宜接口使模型能够持续记录进展、事实和未决问题。 它通过todo.update()更新此记录,并通过todo.list()检索.
状态可以区分待完成的工作、尝试的改变、未经核实的改变以及声称的核查,从而帮助模型跟踪仍然需要检查的内容。 这些条目记录了模型的评估,而不是独立核实环境。

blocks.en:
Action Intent. The intent annotation makes the purpose of each code-execution step explicit. Before each program runs, the model provides a short <intent> block stating what the code is intended to accomplish. A program may combine many operations, making its overall purpose difficult to infer from the code alone.
In real-device use, the harness can display this description to users, helping them understand what the agent is trying to do at each step without reading the program.
blocks.zh:
行动意图。 意向说明使每个代码执行步骤的目的明确. 在每个程序运行前,模型会提供一个短的"intent"块,说明代码打算完成什么. 一个程序可能结合了许多操作,使其整体目的难以从代码中推断出来.
在真设备的用法中,被带可以向用户显示这个描述,帮助他们理解代理在不读出程序的情况下每一步都试图做什么.

blocks.en: Harness-Managed Context. The harness manages historical tool outputs and screenshots through two fixed policies. A rolling screenshot buffer removes older images in batches, limiting visual context while reducing disruption to prompt caching ( Anthropic, 2026a ) . Micro-compaction applies a similar rolling-buffer policy to textual tool outputs, replacing older outputs with short placeholders in batches while retaining recent results. These retention decisions remain with the harness, complementing the model’s choices about when to obtain new observations and how to track task progress.
blocks.zh: 管理环境。 该工具通过两项固定政策管理历史工具产出和截图。 一个滚动的截图缓冲器在分批删除了更旧的图像,限制了视觉上下文,同时将中断减少为即时缓冲(Anthropic, 2026a.). 微型公司对文本工具产出采用类似的滚动缓冲政策,用分批的短位数取代了更老的产出,同时保留了最近的成果。 这些保留决定仍然掌握在手中,补充了模型关于何时获得新观察以及如何跟踪任务进展的选择。

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Representative Harness-to-Model Decision Transfer Patterns
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 代表对模式决策转移模式

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows these interfaces in model outputs. The examples come from GPT-6 Astra trajectories on OSWorld-v2. They illustrate the mechanisms, not their individual effects on task success.
blocks.zh: 图5显示了模型输出中的这些界面. 例子出自OSWorld-v2上的GPT-6 Astra轨迹. 它们说明了各种机制,而不是它们各自对任务成功的影响。

blocks.en: Requesting Visual Feedback Only When Needed. In a calendar task, the model checks saved events and calls screenshot() . Its next input contains text output and a new screenshot. The following program inspects event styles without requesting another image, so the next input contains text feedback but no new screenshot. These adjacent steps show the observation decision: the model can request visual input or continue with programmatic feedback. Earlier screenshots may still remain in context.
blocks.zh: 仅在需要时请求视觉反馈 。 在日历任务中,模型检查保存了事件并调用截图(). 它的下个输入包含文本输出和一个新的截图. 以下程序检查事件样式而不要求其他图像,因此下个输入包含文本反馈,但没有新的截图. 这些相邻步骤显示了观察决定:模型可以请求视觉输入或者继续程序反馈. 早期的截图可能仍然属于背景。

blocks.en: Keeping Unfinished Work Explicit across Programs. In a form-filling task, the model records that all fields have been entered but submission is still pending. It marks the task changed_unverified . After a later program clicks Submit and reads the page’s confirmation, the model updates the same record to claimed_verified . The persistent record distinguishes work performed from an outcome checked. Its status remains the model’s assessment, not an independent evaluation.
blocks.zh: 在整个方案中明确保持未完成的工作。 在填表任务中,模型记录了所有字段已经输入,但提交仍未完成。 它标志着任务的变化_ 未经证实 。 在后来的程序点击了“提交”并读取了该页面的确认后,该模型更新了同样的记录以声称_验证。 长期记录区分了所完成的工作和所检查的结果。 它的地位仍然是模式的评估,而不是独立的评估。

blocks.en: Stating a Program’s Purpose before Execution. In a CRM task, one intent statement summarizes a 64-line program: update 29 lead statuses while preserving the original customer details. The program performs status-only updates and checks other fields, allowing modification timestamps to change. The <intent> block makes both the intended change and the preservation requirement explicit without requiring the reader to reconstruct them from the code.
blocks.zh: 在执行前说明方案的目的。 在一个CRM任务中,一个意向声明总结了一个64行程序:在保留原始客户细节的同时更新29个领先状态. 程序只执行状态更新并检查其他字段,允许修改时间戳来更改. " intent " 块使预期的更改和保存要求都明确,而不要求读者从代码中重建。

(b) A form record remains unverified until the model reads submission confirmation.

blocks.en: 3.3 Experiments on Agent Design
blocks.zh: 3.3 代理设计实验

blocks.en: We evaluate whether the agent design presented in this report helps frontier models complete computer tasks more effectively. We first compare the full GCUA configuration with a GUI-only baseline that already supports batched actions. We then separate the effects of interface access, code execution, and harness-to-model decision transfer.
blocks.zh: 我们评价本报告提出的代理设计是否有助于前沿模型更有效地完成计算机任务。 我们首先将GCUA的完整配置与已经支持分批动作的GUI唯一基线进行比较. 然后我们分离界面访问的效果 代码执行 以及控制到模式的决定转移

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Models and Configuration
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 模式和配置

blocks.en: Benchmark and Models. Following the evaluation protocol of the GPT-6 Astra release ( OpenAI, 2026c ) , we evaluate on the 82-task offline subset of OSWorld-v2 (v2.1) ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , which excludes the 26 tasks that require internet access and so keeps results independent of external websites at run time. The main comparison covers eight models: Claude Opus 5, GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Qwen3.8-Max, Qwen3.8-Flash, Kimi K3, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and GLM-5.3-Flash.
blocks.zh: 基准和模式。 在GPT-6 Astra发布(OpenAI, 2026c)的评价协议之后,我们评价OSWorld-v2(v2.1)的82任务离线子集(Yuan等, 2026),其中排除了需要互联网访问的26个任务,因此在运行时将结果独立于外部网站. 主要比较包括八个模式: Claude Opus 5,GPT-6 Astra,双子座 3.8 Flash,Quen3.8-Max,Quen3.8-Flash,Kimi K3,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash,和GLM-5.3-Flash.

blocks.en: Execution Configurations. The CUA baseline uses GUI-only interaction with batched actions enabled. The full Open Generalist CUA ( OpenGCUA ) configuration combines code execution over GUI and shell operations with the model-initiated workflow control and harness-managed context policies described above. For the ablations of code execution, harness-to-model decision transfer, and harness-managed context policies, we explicitly specify which components are enabled in each setting.
blocks.zh: 执行配置 。 CUA基线使用只有图形用户界面的交互,并启用了分批动作. 完整的Open Generalist CUA(OpenGCUA)配置将代码执行与GUI和 shell操作相结合,并与上述模型启动的工作流程控制和被使用管理的背景政策相配合. 关于代码执行、利用到模式决策的转移以及利用到管理的背景政策,我们明确规定每个环境都启用哪些组成部分。

blocks.en: Metrics. We evaluate task performance and execution efficiency. Following OSWorld-v2, we report binary success and partial-credit scores to measure full and partial task completion, respectively. We measure efficiency by mean steps per task and mean output tokens per task.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们评价任务执行情况和执行效率。 继OSWorld-v2之后,我们分别报告二进制成功和部分信用分数,以衡量全部和部分任务完成情况. 我们用每个任务的平均步骤和每个任务的平均产出符号来衡量效率。

blocks.en: 3.3.2 CUA versus GCUA
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 海关总署诉海关总署

blocks.en: Table 2: CUA versus OpenGCUA on the OSWorld-v2 offline set. Each model is evaluated with a GUI-only baseline that supports batched actions and the full GCUA configuration with code execution and harness-to-model decision transfer. Bold marks the better value within each model and metric. K denotes 1,000 tokens.
blocks.zh: 表2:OSWorld-v2下线集上的CUA对OpenGCUA. 每个模型都使用一个仅支持分批动作的GUI基线进行评价,并使用代码执行和从控制到模式的决定传输的GCUA全配置. 粗体标出每个模型和度量中更好的价值。 K 表示1000个令牌.

blocks.en: We compare the conventional GUI-only CUA setting with the full OpenGCUA configuration to examine the performance and efficiency gains from moving toward generalist computer use. OpenGCUA gives the model greater control over what to observe, how to act, and how to organize its work. The CUA baseline already supports batched actions, while OpenGCUA combines code execution with harness-to-model decision transfer.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了传统的仅GUI的 CUA 设置和完整的 OpenGCUA 配置,以检查从向通论式计算机使用方向发展获得的性能和效率收益. OpenGCUA给予模型更大的控制,以观察什么,如何行动,如何组织其工作. CUA基线已经支持了分批动作,而OpenGCUA则结合了代码执行和取用到模型的决定转移.

blocks.en: OpenGCUA improves task scores and reduces steps across all eight models. As shown in Table 2 , the cross-model mean partial score increases from 45.3 to 64.9, a gain of 19.6 points , while steps per task decrease by an average of 53.0% , computed from each model’s relative reduction. The largest score gains reach 35.2 points for GLM-5.3-Flash and 29.8 points for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Full-task success also increases for every model. These results show a substantial gap between batched GUI-only execution and the full OpenGCUA design in both task performance and interaction efficiency.
blocks.zh: OpenGCUA改进了任务分数,并减少了所有8个模型的步数. 如表2所示,跨模型的分数从45.3分增加到64.9分,增加19.6分,而每个任务的步骤平均减少53.0%,从每个模型的相对减少量计算。 最大得分收益为GLM-5.3-Flash35.2分,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash29.8分. 每个模型的全任务成功率也增加。 这些结果显示,批量的GUI只执行和完整的OpenGCUA设计在任务性能和交互效率上都有很大差距.

blocks.en: The gains hold despite large differences in baseline performance and efficiency. The benefits are not limited to models with low initial task scores. GPT-6 Astra, which has the highest baseline score, improves from 67.1 to 75.7 and reduces steps per task from 102.1 to 33.5, a 67.2% reduction. At the other end of the efficiency range, Qwen3.8-Flash starts with 232.0 steps per task, yet gains 21.6 points while using 62.8% fewer steps. The consistent improvements across all 8 frontier models support the broad applicability of the OpenGCUA design.
blocks.zh: 尽管基线性能和效率存在很大差异,但收益仍维持不变。 好处不仅限于初始任务分数低的模型. 基准分数最高的GPT-6 Astra的成绩从67.1%提高到75.7%,并将每个任务的步数从102.1%减少到33.5,降幅为67.2%。 在效率范围的另一端,Qwen3.8-Flash从每个任务232.0步起步,但提高21.6分,同时使用更低的62.8分. 所有8个前沿模型的一致改进支持了OpenGCUA设计的广泛适用性.

blocks.en: Fewer interaction steps do not necessarily require fewer output tokens. Output tokens per task decrease for six of the eight models, with an average relative reduction of 27.2% . Claude Opus 5 reduces its output from 378.3K to 89.3K tokens per task, and Kimi K3 from 302.5K to 139.6K. GPT-6 Astra, however, uses approximately the same output-token budget, despite its large reduction in steps. Fewer steps per task can reduce model round trips and their overhead, even without reducing output tokens. End-to-end latency must be measured separately, accounting for model response time and tool execution time. We report both steps and output tokens to distinguish interaction efficiency from output-token usage.
blocks.zh: 互动步骤较少并不一定需要较少的输出符. 8个模型中,6个模型的每个任务输出信号减少,平均相对减少27.2%。 克劳德 Opus 5将其输出从每个任务378.3K减少到89.3K令牌,而Kimi K3则从302.5K减少到139.6K. 然而,GPT-6 Astra使用的产出计算预算大致相同,尽管其步骤大为减少。 每个任务步骤较少,即使不减少输出符,也可以减少模型回程和它们的间接费用. 端到端间隔期必须分别计量,核算模型响应时间和工具执行时间. 我们既报告步骤,也报告输出符号,以区分交互效率与输出调用。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Code-execution ablation on OSWorld-v2. Code execution achieves higher task scores and fewer steps than single-action GUI, batched GUI, and batched GUI+CLI setting across all three models.
blocks.zh: 图6:OSWorld-v2上的代码执行禁用. 代码执行比单动作图形界面,分批图形界面,分批GUI+CLI在所有三种模型中实现更高的任务分数和更少的步骤.

blocks.en: 3.3.3 GUI+CLI Hybrid CUA versus GCUA
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 GUI+CLI混合CUA对GCUA

blocks.en: Table 3: Full GCUA versus batched GUI+CLI.
blocks.zh: 表3: 完整的GCUA相对于分批的GUI+CLI.

blocks.en: GUI+CLI hybrid agents have become an active direction in computer-use research ( Song et al., 2026 ) , including our previous work, Qwen-UI-Agent ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . As discussed in Section 2.1 , the batched GUI+CLI formulation is a special case of GCUA. We compare this baseline with the full OpenGCUA setting. Both provide GUI and CLI access, but OpenGCUA introduces code execution and model-initiated workflow control, letting the model decide what to observe, how to act, and how to organize its work.
blocks.zh: GUI+CLI混合剂已经成为了计算机使用研究的积极方向(Song等,2026年),包括我们之前的作品"Quen-UI-Agent"(周等,2026年). 如第2.1节所讨论,分批的GUI+CLI配制是GCUA的特例. 我们把这个基线与OpenGCUA的全部设置进行比较。 两者都提供GUI和CLI访问,但OpenGCUA引入了代码执行和模型启动的工作流程控制,让模型决定观察什么,如何行动,如何组织其工作.

blocks.en: OpenGCUA achieves higher task scores with fewer reported steps. In the selected runs, OpenGCUA increases task scores by 4.4 to 9.1 points across all four models, with lower reported steps per task (Table 3 ). Qwen3.8-Max improves from 57.2 to 64.0 with 13.8% fewer steps , while GLM-5.3-Flash improves from 55.8 to 64.9 with 7.6% fewer steps . These results suggest that effective hybrid computer use depends not only on interface access, but also on control over execution and workflow. Code execution lets intermediate results determine subsequent GUI and shell operations within a single program. Harness-to-model decision transfer extends the model’s control to when visual feedback is requested and how task progress is recorded. The comparison evaluates these mechanisms jointly.
blocks.zh: OpenGCUA通过较少的步骤实现更高的任务分数. 在所选运行中,OpenGCUA将任务分数在所有四个模型中都增加了4.4分到9.1分,每个任务报告的分数更低(表3. GLM-5.3-Flash从55.8级升至64.9级, 这些结果表明,有效的混合计算机使用不仅取决于接口访问,而且取决于对执行和工作流程的控制. 代码执行让中间结果决定一个程序内后续的GUI和 shell操作. 和谐到模式的决定转移将模型的控制扩展到何时要求视觉反馈以及如何记录任务进度. 比较后将联合评价这些机制。

blocks.en: 3.3.4 Code-Execution Ablation
blocks.zh: 3.3.4 守则执行

blocks.en: Code execution improves task scores and reduces interaction steps. We compare four execution configurations for Qwen3.8-Max, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and GLM-5.3-Flash: single-action GUI execution, batched GUI actions, batched GUI+CLI actions, and code execution over GUI and CLI operations. In the selected runs, code execution achieves higher task scores and fewer steps than each alternative across all three models (Figure 6 ). Relative to batched GUI actions, task scores improve by 15.5 to 33.6 points , while steps per task decrease by 55.3% to 63.1% .
blocks.zh: 代码执行可以改进任务分数并减少交互步骤. 我们比较了Quen3.8-Max、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和GLM-5.3-Flash的四个执行配置:单动作GUI执行,分批GUI动作,分批GUI+CLI动作,以及GUI和CLI操作的代码执行. 在所选运行中,代码执行在所有三种模式中都实现了更高的任务分数和比每个选项更少的步数(图6. 相对于批量的GUI动作,任务分数提高了15.5分到33.6分,而每个任务的步骤则下降了55.3%到63.1%.

blocks.en: Executable control adds value beyond GUI+CLI access. The batched GUI+CLI baseline provides the same interfaces and already supports shell scripts. Nevertheless, code execution raises GLM-5.3-Flash’s task score from 55.8 to 63.2, a gain of 7.4 points , and reduces Qwen3.8-Max’s steps per task from 66.1 to 54.9, a 17.0% reduction . The key distinction is how operations are coordinated within a step. A batch fixes the sequence of GUI and shell actions in advance, whereas a program can use intermediate results to determine subsequent operations across both interfaces. Loops, conditional branches, and retries can thus consolidate work that might otherwise require multiple model calls. This unified interface also lets models apply their existing programming capabilities directly to computer interaction, rather than expressing computer interaction through a separate action-list format. Together, these properties may help explain the observed improvements in task scores and interaction efficiency.
blocks.zh: 可执行控制在GUI+CLI访问之外会增加值. 分批的GUI+CLI基线提供了相同的接口并已经支持了 shell脚本. 不过,代码执行将GLM-5.3-Flash的任务分数从55.8分提高到63.2分,增加7.4分,并将Qune3.8-Max的步数从66.1分降到54.9分,减少17.0%。 关键区别在于如何在一步内协调行动。 一个批次提前修正了GUI和 shell 动作的顺序,而一个程序可以使用中间结果来确定两个接口的后继操作. 循环,有条件的分会,再会,从而可以巩固本来可能需要多个模型调用的工作. 这种统一的接口也让模型将现有的编程能力直接应用于计算机交互,而不是通过单独的动作列表格式表达计算机交互. 这些属性加在一起可能有助于解释所观察到的任务分数和互动效率的改进.

blocks.en: 3.3.5 Harness-to-Model Decision Transfer Ablation
blocks.zh: 3.3.5 调剂调剂

blocks.en: Most mechanisms are not designed primarily to improve task scores. We ablate the mechanisms supporting harness-to-model decision transfer and the harness-managed context policies. Using code execution as the baseline, we add each feature separately and then combine all features for Qwen3.8-Max and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (Table 4 ). While todo aims to support task completion, the other features primarily target observation efficiency, interpretability, or context management. We therefore assess cache reuse where relevant and check whether task scores are maintained.
blocks.zh: 大多数机制的设计主要不是为了提高任务分数. 我们放弃支持利用到模式的决策转移和利用管理的背景政策的机制。 以代码执行为基线,我们分别添加每个特性,然后结合了Qune3.8-Max和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的所有特性(表4). 虽然待办事宜旨在支持完成任务,但其他特征主要针对观察效率、可解释性或上下文管理。 因此,我们酌情评估缓存再利用情况并检查是否维持了任务分数。

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation of harness-to-model decision transfer and harness-managed context policies. Each mechanism is added separately to code execution; the final row combines all mechanisms. Cache hit is the fraction of input tokens served from cache; dashes indicate omitted rates.
blocks.zh: 表4:利用到模式的决策转移和利用到管理的背景政策之间的关系。 每个机制被单独添加到代码执行中;最后一行结合了所有机制. 缓存命中是从缓存中发送的输入符的分数;破折号表示省略的速率.

blocks.en: On-demand observation improves cache reuse. The screenshot action lets the model omit screenshots when program output is sufficient, aiming to reduce unnecessary visual context. In the selected runs, cache hit rises from 75.6% to 86.1% for Qwen3.8-Max and from 61.9% to 76.3% for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, with higher task scores in both cases.
blocks.zh: 点播观察可以改善缓存再利用. 截图动作让模型在程序输出足够时省略截图,旨在减少不必要的视觉上下文. 在所选跑道中,Qune3.8-Max的缓存命中率从75.6%上升到86.1%;DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的缓存命中率从61.9%上升到76.3%,两者的任务分数都较高.

blocks.en: Task-state tracking and action intent serve distinct goals. The todo interface supports task completion by maintaining a record of progress and unresolved work. Task score increases from 62.4 to 64.0 for Qwen3.8-Max and from 56.7 to 58.5 for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. In contrast, the intent annotation makes each program’s purpose explicit so that real-device users can understand what the agent is doing. Its primary goal is user understanding rather than benchmark performance. Scores fall slightly.
blocks.zh: 任务状态跟踪和行动意图服务于不同的目标。 待办事宜接口通过保持进度记录和未解决的工作支持任务完成. 任务分数由62.4分增至64.0分的Qune3.8-Max分,由56.7分增至58.5分的DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash分. 相形之下,意向注解使得每个程序的目的都明确,这样真设备的用户就能理解代理正在做什么. 其主要目标是用户理解而不是基准业绩。 分数略有下降.

blocks.en: Cache reuse and context length matter for practical agent execution. As interaction histories grow, context policies must control their length while preserving cache reuse. The rolling screenshot buffer removes older images in batches, reducing how often prior context is modified. In the selected runs, cache hit improves by 16.0 and 13.4 percentage points for Qwen3.8-Max and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, respectively. Micro-compaction instead replaces older tool outputs with short placeholders to limit context growth, at the potential cost of invalidating cached prefixes. Cache hit falls from 75.6% to 68.6% for Qwen3.8-Max, and from 61.9% to 58.9% for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Neither context policy lowers task score in these selected comparisons.
blocks.zh: 缓存再利用和上下文长度物质用于实际代理执行. 随着互动历史的增长,背景政策必须控制其长度,同时保留缓存再利用. 滚动的截图缓冲器会分批去除更老的图像,减少先前上下文被修改的频率. 在所选跑道中,缓存命中分别提高了16.0和13.4个百分点的Qune3.8-Max和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. 取而代之的是用短的占位符来取而代之的旧工具输出,以限制上下文增长,其代价可能是取消缓存前缀. Qwen3.8-Max的缓存命中率从75.6%下降到68.6%,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的命中率从61.9%下降到58.9%. 在这些选定的比较中,上下文政策都没有降低任务分数。

blocks.en: 3.3.6 How Much Task Performance Can Money and Time Buy?
blocks.zh: 3.3.6 金钱和时间能花费多少任务?

blocks.en: Final benchmark scores alone do not show how much performance is available under limited resources. We therefore examine monetary and time constraints using the same selected full-setting runs as the main evaluation on the offline subset of OSWorld-v2.
blocks.zh: 仅靠最后基准分数并不能显示在有限资源下有多少业绩。 因此,我们利用与OSWorld-v2离线子集的主要评价相同的选定全面设定程序来审查货币和时间限制。

blocks.en:
Measuring Performance under Resource Limits. We retrospectively apply a common spending cap to every task. A trajectory contributes its recorded final partial score only if its full cost fits within the cap; otherwise, it contributes zero.
We estimate spending by assuming that each attempt ends when its recorded trajectory finishes or its spending cap is reached, whichever comes first. Spending on unsuccessful attempts is also included.
Figure 7 (a) plots the resulting score against average expenditure per task, not the cap itself. Panel (b) applies the same scoring rule to a per-task time limit. Scores are averaged over all tasks.

我们估计开支的方式是假定每次尝试在记录的轨迹完成或支出上限达到时即告结束,以时间在先者为准。 还列入了未成功努力的开支。
图7(a) 对照每项任务的平均支出,而不是上限本身,列出结果的分数。 小组(b)对每项任务的时限适用同样的评分规则。 在所有任务中平均得分。

blocks.en: Notably, recorded wall-clock time depends on API bandwidth and rate limits, the number of concurrently active evaluation environments, provider-side queuing, and tool execution latency. These conditions were not controlled across models, limiting the comparability of the measurements. We therefore report the time curves as exploratory evidence and treat their trends as indicative rather than conclusive.

blocks.en: Money and Time Favor Different Models. Under the assumed API prices, the highest-scoring model shifts from Qwen3.8-Flash to GLM-5.3-Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and eventually GPT-6 Astra as the monetary budget increases. For example, Qwen3.8-Flash reaches 60.5 points at approximately $0.38 per task, whereas GPT-6 Astra reaches the highest score of 75.7 at approximately $15.26 per task. In the recorded-time comparison, however, GPT-6 Astra achieves higher scores at most time limits.
