blocks.en: From Benchmark Scores to Resource-Aware Model Selection. In practice, the relevant question is not only which model achieves the highest benchmark score, but which delivers the most task performance within a given budget or an acceptable completion time. These curves make this distinction explicit: models with lower final scores may be preferable under tighter resource constraints.
blocks.zh: 从基准分数到资源-软件模型选择。 在实践中,相关问题不仅在于哪一种模式达到最高基准分数,而且在于哪一种模式在特定预算或可接受的完成时间内交付了最多的任务业绩. 这些曲线明确了这种区别:在更严格的资源制约下,最终得分较低的模型可能更好.

blocks.en: 4 Real-Device Generalist CUA
blocks.zh: 4 实名制通用技术

blocks.en:
In Section 3 , we study code execution and harness-to-model decision transfer on OSWorld-v2, where every task runs in a controlled benchmark environment. Users, however, run agents on their own computers.
There, the environment is not initialized for the task, many application windows overlap, the user works at the same time, and requests change as the task goes on, so an agent that performs well on a benchmark may still struggle on a real device.
This section first describes how real devices differ from benchmarks (Section 4.1 ). It then presents the Cross-Device SDK, the programming interface through which the model operates different devices (Section 4.2 ), and the harness we built for real devices, organized into five layers with clear responsibilities (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh:
在第3节中,我们在OSWorld-v2上研究代码执行和对模型化决策的转移,因为每个任务都运行在受控制的基准环境中. 然而,用户在自己的计算机上运行代理.
在那里,环境对任务没有初始化,许多应用程序窗口重叠,用户同时工作,随着任务的持续而请求改变,因此一个在基准上表现良好的代理仍然可能在真正的设备上挣扎.
本节首先说明实际装置与基准的不同之处(第4.1节)。 然后介绍Cross-Device SDK,即模型运行不同设备的编程接口(第4.2节),以及我们为真实设备所搭建的用具,分为五层,责任明确(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 The Gap Between Benchmarks and Real Machines
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准与实际机器之间的差距

blocks.en: Controlled computer-use evaluations typically provide prepared task states, an initial instruction, and an environment reserved for the agent. Such settings simplify evaluation but do not fully capture the demands of operating a user’s computer. We highlight five requirements that become especially important when the agent works alongside a user in an existing, changing environment.
blocks.zh: 受控制的计算机使用评价通常提供已准备好的任务状态、初步指示和为制剂保留的环境。 这种设置简化了评价,但不能完全抓住操作用户计算机的要求。 我们强调,当代理人与用户在不断变化的现有环境中工作时,五项要求变得特别重要。

blocks.en: The user and agent share control. The user may continue working while the agent runs, so the agent cannot assume exclusive control of the pointer, keyboard, or focused window. It must account for user activity rather than attribute every change to its own actions. Where supported, it should prefer accessibility actions or background-window operations that leave the user’s current interaction undisturbed. When these methods cannot complete an operation, foreground interaction requires coordination with the user before taking control.
blocks.zh: 用户和代理共享控制. 用户可以在代理运行时继续工作,因此代理无法独占指针,键盘,或焦点窗口的控制. 它必须说明用户的活动,而不是将每个变化归结为自己的行动。 在得到支持的地方,它应该倾向于无障碍动作或背景窗口操作,使用户当前的互动不受干扰。 当这些方法不能完成一个操作时,前景交互需要与用户协调才能控制.

blocks.en: The screen keeps changing. Application windows open, close, and move, and one window can cover another. These changes may come from applications unrelated to the task and continue while the agent is reasoning. A coordinate or element reference that was valid when observed may therefore be wrong by the time the agent acts.
blocks.zh: 屏幕一直在变 应用程序窗口打开,关闭,移动,一个窗口可以覆盖另一个窗口. 这些变化可能来自与任务无关的应用程序,并在代理是推理时继续. 因此,在被观察到时有效的坐标或要素参照可能因代理人的行为而是错误的。

blocks.en: User requests evolve during execution. Users may clarify an initial request, correct the agent’s approach, or add constraints as work proceeds. The agent must keep track of the overall task goal and relevant progress across interruptions and turns, while revising its plan to reflect the user’s latest instructions.
blocks.zh: 用户请求在执行过程中会演变. 用户可以澄清初始请求,纠正代理人的做法,或在工作进行过程中增加限制。 代理商必须跟踪总体任务目标以及贯穿中断和转弯的相关进展,同时修订其计划以反映用户的最新指示.

blocks.en: Observation and control require explicit targets. On a user’s computer, the task-relevant application, window, or browser tab need not be in the foreground. A full-desktop screenshot shows the visible composition of windows, not the contents of every addressable target. The model must therefore choose both what to inspect and how to inspect it: a target-specific image, an accessibility tree, or a programmatic query may expose different aspects of the same target. For example, an agent inspecting a background product page may receive an unrelated login page if it requests a desktop screenshot rather than an image of the selected tab, as illustrated in Section 4.3.4 .
blocks.zh: 观察和控制需要明确的目标。 在用户的计算机上,与任务相关的应用程序,窗口或浏览器标签无需放在前台. 全桌面截图显示窗口的可见组成,而不是每个可地址目标的内容. 因此,模型必须既选择检查什么,又选择如何检查:一个针对特定目标的图像,一个可访问的树,或者一个程序查询可能暴露同一个目标的不同方面. 例如,如第4.3.4节所说明的,检查背景产品页面的代理人如果要求桌面截图而非所选标签的图像,可能会收到一个无关的登录页面。

blocks.en: Observation and control also impose different requirements. Being able to inspect a background target does not imply that every operation on it can run in the background. The model must select a supported control method, while the harness makes target identities, available capabilities, and foreground-input requirements explicit. Observations and actions should remain tied to their selected targets rather than silently following changes in desktop focus. These requirements link the model’s observation and action choices to the resource bindings and capability declarations in the Cross-Device SDK (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 观察和控制也规定了不同的要求。 能够检查一个背景目标并不意味着它上的所有操作都可以在背景中运行. 该模型必须选择一种支持的控制方法,而这种控制使目标身份、现有能力和前景投入要求变得明确。 观察和行动仍应与其选定的目标挂钩,而不是默默地跟踪桌面焦点的变化。 这些要求将模型的观察和行动选择与交叉Device SDK(第4.2节)中的资源约束和能力申报联系起来。

blocks.en: Tasks begin in an existing user environment. Benchmark tasks typically start from a prepared state. A user’s computer instead retains files, open tabs, application windows, and account sessions from prior use. Relevant materials may be mixed with unrelated content or similarly named files, requiring the agent to identify the correct inputs before acting. Expired sessions or missing permissions may also require user involvement before execution can continue.
blocks.zh: 任务开始于现有的用户环境中. 基准任务通常从准备状态开始。 用户的计算机则保留文件、打开标签、应用程序窗口和账户会话。 相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相同相關相關相關相相關相關相關相相關相關相相相相相相同相相相相同相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 过期会话或缺失权限也可能需要用户参与才能继续执行.

blocks.en: These requirements mean that benchmark scores alone do not establish reliable operation on users’ devices. We therefore study real-device capability alongside benchmark performance, rather than treating deployment as an implementation detail. The following sections describe our SDK and harness, and Section 4.3.3 reports preliminary real-device results.
blocks.zh: 这些要求意味着,单凭基准得分并不能确定用户设备的可靠操作。 因此,我们除了研究基准业绩外,还研究实际能力,而不是将部署作为执行细节。 以下各节介绍我们的SDK和利用情况,第4.3.3节报告初步实际检测结果。

blocks.en: 4.2 Cross-Device SDK
blocks.zh: 4.2 交叉设备SDK

blocks.en: A computer-use task may span a mobile application, desktop tools, and a browser-based service. The Cross-Device SDK provides a common programming interface through which one agent can coordinate these environments. It supports both the reuse of common operations across platforms and the composition of cross-device workflows within a single task. Its programming model builds on code-execution-based computer-use interfaces ( OpenAI, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 计算机使用任务可能跨越移动应用程序,桌面工具和基于浏览器的服务. Cross-Device SDK提供了一个共同的编程接口,通过这个接口,一个代理可以协调这些环境. 它既支持跨平台共同操作的再利用,也支持单个任务内交叉设备工作流程的构成. 其编程模式以基于代码执行的计算机使用界面为基础(OpenAI,2026b;OpenAI,2026a.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Architecture of the Cross-Device SDK. A common programming interface connects agent programs to computers, mobile devices, and browser environments, enabling cross-device workflows through platform-specific adapters.
blocks.zh: 图8 跨Device SDK建筑. 通用的编程接口将代理程序与计算机,移动设备,和浏览器环境相接,通过平台专用的适配器实现交叉调试工作流程.

blocks.en: Common operations use a shared vocabulary, while platform adapters implement their native behavior. For example, the macOS adapter uses the unmodified Cua Driver from trycua ( trycua, 2026 ) . Each operation is scoped to an explicit resource, such as a device, application, window, or browser tab. Resource handles retain their targets independently, so selecting a new target does not redirect earlier bindings. This gives agent programs a consistent way to address multiple devices and applications without relying on a single implicitly selected target.
blocks.zh: 共同操作使用共享词汇,而平台适配器则实施其本土行为. 例如:macOS适配器使用从tricua(tricua,2026. 每项操作都被设定为明确的资源,例如设备,应用程序,窗口,或浏览器标签. 资源手柄独立地保留了目标,所以选择一个新的目标不会重新定向更早的绑定. 这使得代理程序在不依赖一个被暗中选择的单一目标的情况下,能够一致地处理多个设备和应用程序.

blocks.en: Within one session, programs can combine observations and actions from multiple resources while reusing host-side variables and bindings across turns. The program executes in the host runtime, whereas device.shell.run executes commands on the selected device where supported. File transfers through mu.files.copy identify both source and destination resources. These mechanisms allow intermediate results from one environment to guide operations in another. As an illustrative workflow, an agent could retrieve a report through a phone application, transfer it to a computer for analysis, and enter the results into a browser-based service, coordinating all three stages within the same task.
blocks.zh: 在一个会话中,程序可以将多种资源的观察和行动结合起来,同时重用主机侧变量和横轮绑定. 程序在主机运行时间执行,而设备则执行. shell.run 在所支持的选定设备上执行命令 。 通过mu.files的文件传输. 副本同时标明来源和目的资源。 这些机制允许一种环境中的中间结果来指导另一种环境中的操作. 作为说明性工作流程,代理商可以通过电话应用程序取回一个报告,将其转移到计算机进行分析,并将结果输入到基于浏览器的服务中,在同一任务中协调所有三个阶段.

blocks.en: The SDK exposes ui.ax for structured semantic observations and element-based actions, and ui.vision for images and coordinate-based interaction. Semantic state supports programmatic conditions and checks, while vision provides complementary information when semantic observations are insufficient. Adapters normalize native accessibility and browser semantic trees into common representations, allowing filtering and compact rendering to be reused across compatible platforms.
blocks.zh: SDK曝出有结构的语义观察和以元素为基础的动作的ui.ax,和图像和以协调为基础的交互的ui.vision. 语义状态支持方案条件和检查,而视觉则在语义观察不充分时提供补充信息. 适配器将本地的可访问性和浏览器语义树规范化为共同的表示,使过滤和紧凑的渲染能够在相容的平台上被再利用.

blocks.en: Observation capture is separate from delivery to the model. Calls such as ui.ax.observe() return data to the program, while mu.emit delivers selected observations or computed results to the model. A program can therefore inspect multiple targets, use structured results to determine subsequent operations, and return only the information needed for the next model decision. This separation supports cross-device execution without requiring a model call for every intermediate structured observation.
blocks.zh: 观测捕捉与交付给模型是分开的. 调用 ui.ax.observe () 将数据返回程序, 而 mu.emit 则向模型发送选定的观测结果或计算结果 。 因此,一个程序可以检查多个目标,使用结构化的结果来确定后续的操作,并且只返回下一个模型决定所需的信息. 这种分离支持跨设备执行,而不需要每个中间结构观测的模型调用.

blocks.en: A common interface does not imply identical capabilities across platforms. Each resource declares its supported operations and options. Common UI operations and device services share interfaces, while platform-specific features remain explicit through namespaces such as .android , .macos , and .browser . Operations such as Android navigation and browser page evaluation thus retain their own semantics, allowing programs to reuse common interaction patterns while selecting methods appropriate to each target.
blocks.zh: 一个共同的接口并不意味着各平台的能力相同。 每个资源都声明其支持的操作和选项. 常见的UI操作与设备服务共享接口,而平台特定功能通过命名空间如.android.,.macos,和.browser等仍然清晰. 因此,Android导航和浏览器页面评价等操作保留了自己的语义,允许程序在选择适合每个目标的方法的同时再利用共同的交互模式.

blocks.en: 4.3 Real-Device Harness
blocks.zh: 4.3 真实设备

blocks.en: Figure 9: Five-layer architecture of the real-device harness. The runtime executes model-generated programs through the SDK and platform drivers to interact with applications and the operating system.
blocks.zh: 图9 实相装置的五层结构. 运行时间通过SDK和平台驱动程序执行模型生成的程序,与应用程序和操作系统互动.

blocks.en: The Cross-Device SDK defines the programming interface for device observation and control. The real-device harness integrates this interface with the agent loop, program execution, and platform-specific mechanisms, enabling the model to work on a user’s computer while retaining task state across turns.
blocks.zh: Cross-Device SDK定义了设备观测和控制的编程接口. 真设备的利用将这个接口与代理环路,程序执行和平台特定机制相融合,使模型能够在保持任务状态的同时在用户的计算机上工作.

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Five-Layer Architecture
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 五层建筑

blocks.en: We separate the system into five layers (Figure 9 ). The model generates a program, the runtime executes it, and SDK calls are translated by the driver into operations on applications and the operating system. Explicit interfaces separate responsibilities and allow compatible components to be replaced independently. Detectable execution failures are reported where they occur; successful action delivery is not treated as evidence that the intended task-level effect has occurred.
blocks.zh: 我们把系统分为五层(图9). 该模型生成一个程序,运行时间执行它,SDK呼叫被驱动程序翻译为应用程序和操作系统的操作. 明确的接口可以分离责任并允许相容组件独立被替换. 可探测的执行失败发生地报告;成功的行动交付不被视为已发生预期任务一级影响的证据。

blocks.en: Model. Conditioned on the task, system prompt, and interaction history, the model decides how to observe, act, and organize its work. It selects targets and operations, maintains task state, and determines when to request user input. These decisions are expressed as Python programs against a common SDK, allowing device operations and programmatic checks to share the same control flow.
blocks.zh: 型号。 该模型以任务,系统即时,互动历史为条件,决定如何观察,行动,组织其工作. 它选择目标和操作,保持任务状态,并确定何时请求用户输入. 这些决定被表述为Python程序来对抗共同的SDK,允许设备操作和程序检查共享相同的控制流.

blocks.en: Runtime. The runtime manages the agent loop and executes programs in a persistent interpreter. Variables, imports, and the working directory persist across turns, supporting incremental execution. It collects execution feedback and explicitly emitted observations, applies the configured context-retention policies, and constructs the next model input.
blocks.zh: 运行时间。 运行时间管理代理循环,并以持续解释器执行程序. 可变因素、进口和工作目录贯穿各行各业,支持逐步执行。 它收集执行反馈和明确发布观察,应用已配置的上下文保留政策,并构建下一个模型输入.

blocks.en: Device SDK. The SDK binds observations and actions to explicit resources, such as devices, windows, and browser tabs (Section 4.2 ). Short element IDs written directly by the model must originate from observations delivered to it; programs may also obtain element references from fresh observations and use them within the same execution. Resource resets or rebinding invalidate associated references. These constraints establish the provenance and scope of action targets, but do not guarantee that the interface remains unchanged before execution.
blocks.zh: 设备 SDK. SDK将观察和动作绑定为明确的资源,如设备,窗口和浏览器标签(第4.2节). 由模型直接撰写的短元素ID必须来源于提供给它的观测;程序还可以从新的观测中获取元素引用并在同一执行中使用. 资源重置或重新绑定无效相关引用 。 这些制约因素确定了行动目标的出处和范围,但不能保证执行前接口保持不变.

blocks.en: Driver. The driver translates SDK requests into supported native operations, including accessibility actions and coordinate-based input. It manages element identities and snapshot metadata, selects action-delivery mechanisms, and applies foreground or background delivery policies. Detectable native failures are returned as typed errors so that the agent can distinguish execution failures from outcomes requiring further inspection.
blocks.zh: 驾驶员 驱动程序将SDK请求转换为被支持的本地操作,包括无障碍行动和以协调为基础的输入. 它管理元素身份和快照元数据,选择行动交付机制,并适用前景或背景交付政策。 可检测的本地故障作为打出的错误返回,以便代理人能够区分执行故障和需要进一步检查的结果.

blocks.en: Applications and Operating System. Applications and the operating system determine the available observations and control capabilities. Permissions, application state, and accessibility support constrain which operations can be performed. The harness must expose these limitations and use alternative interaction methods where supported.
blocks.zh: 应用与操作系统. 应用程序和操作系统决定可用的观测和控制能力. 权限、应用状态和可访问性支持制约了可执行的操作。 利用手段必须暴露这些局限性,并在得到支持的地方使用其他互动方法。

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Responding to Real-Device Challenges
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 应对实际设备的挑战

blocks.en: The constraints discussed in Section 4.1 motivate four design choices that connect these layers.
blocks.zh: 第4.1节讨论的限制因素促使人们选择了连接这些地层的四个设计选择。

blocks.en: Minimizing Interference on Shared Machines. An agent operating alongside a user cannot assume exclusive control of the pointer, keyboard, or focused window. The harness therefore prefers element-level accessibility actions, followed by window-targeted coordinate input, and finally foreground input. Background delivery is used only where the target and platform support it; window-relative coordinates alone do not imply background execution. When a less intrusive method is unavailable or ineffective, the agent can escalate to a supported alternative, coordinating with the user before foreground input.
blocks.zh: 尽量减少对共享机器的干扰。 与用户一起运行的代理不能独占指针,键盘,或焦点窗口的控制. 因此,这一工具倾向于采取元素层面的无障碍行动,然后是针对窗口的坐标输入,最后是前景输入。 背景交付仅在目标和平台支持时使用;仅窗口相对坐标并不意味着背景执行. 当侵入性较弱的方法无法使用或无效时,代理可以升级为被支持的替代品,在前景输入前与用户协调.

blocks.en: Selecting Observations Explicitly. A full-desktop screenshot may show the user’s activity rather than the agent’s target, and visual input may be unnecessary during programmatic work. Following the model-initiated observation design in Section 3.2 , the agent chooses when to observe and which target to inspect. A program can capture observations, process structured results, and emit relevant information within one execution; images are interpreted by the model when delivered in a subsequent input. Bounded history and image retention limit accumulated context. These mechanisms reduce unnecessary observations, but do not eliminate the need to refresh state when the interface changes.
blocks.zh: 选择观测结果 明说. 全台屏幕截图可能显示用户的活动而不是代理的目标,在方案工作期间可能没有必要进行视觉输入。 按照3.2节中模型启动的观察设计,代理人选择观察时间和检查目标。 一个程序可以在一次执行中获取观测,处理结构化的结果,并释放出相关信息;图像在发送到后续输入时由模型解释. 边界历史和图像保存限制 累积上下文。 这些机制减少了不必要的观察,但并不排除在界面改变时刷新状态的需要.

blocks.en: Managing Accessibility Information. Accessibility observations vary in size, stability, and coverage across applications. The harness filters irrelevant nodes and represents the retained hierarchy as a flat list linked by parent_id . Element identities and snapshot versions support reference tracking, while search , page , and read retrieve relevant information from a retained snapshot without repeatedly capturing the window. When accessibility information is insufficient, visual observation provides a complementary source of evidence. The choice of action-delivery mechanism remains separate from the choice of observation modality.
blocks.zh: 管理无障碍信息。 无障碍观测在规模、稳定性和覆盖面方面各有不同。 带子过滤不相干节点,并代表保留等级,作为由父目录链接的平面列表_id. 元素身份和快照版本支持参考跟踪,同时搜索,页面,并读取保留快照中的相关信息而无需再多捕捉到窗口. 当无障碍信息不足时,视觉观察提供了补充证据来源. 行动-交付机制的选择与观察方式的选择仍然是分开的。

blocks.en: Maintaining Task Continuity through User Interaction. Real-device tasks may require clarification, authentication, or authorization that the agent cannot supply independently. The ask_user interface supports these exchanges, including resolving ambiguous targets, requesting assistance with login or verification, and obtaining authorization for consequential actions. User responses and corrections become part of the ongoing task. The runtime preserves interpreter state, resource bindings, and interaction history, allowing execution to resume without rebuilding the workflow.
blocks.zh: 通过用户互动保持任务连续性。 真正的设备任务可能需要澄清、认证或授权,而代理人不能独立提供。 ask_user接口支持这些交换,包括解决模棱两可的目标,请求协助登录或核查,并获得相应行动的许可. 用户的回应和纠正成为目前工作的一部分。 运行时间保存了解释器状态,资源绑定,以及交互历史,使得执行可以在不重建工作流程的情况下恢复.

blocks.en: Table 5: Real-device results on four macOS tasks. Costs and completion use the same selected run per task (run 1). Costs are four-task means; Complete counts tasks judged complete. DeepSeek lacks a hotel trajectory, so its aggregates are unavailable.
blocks.zh: 表5:真实设备对四个macOS任务的结果. 每个任务(运行一)的费用和完成使用相同的选定运行。 费用是四项任务; 完成计算任务。 DeepSeek缺乏酒店的轨迹,因此其总和没有.

blocks.en: 4.3.3 Preliminary Real-Device Results
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 初步真实结果

blocks.en: As our real-device benchmark is still under development, we study seven model configurations on four macOS tasks: workbook reasoning, PDF form filling, dietary-constrained shopping research, and hotel comparison, with up to three recorded runs per task and model. Table 5 summarizes five configurations, reporting mean interaction costs across all four tasks, including incomplete tasks. Steps count model responses, and output tokens include reasoning where recorded. Dollar costs are estimated from recorded response usage, cache hits, and public API prices.
blocks.zh: 由于我们的真设备基准仍在开发中,我们研究了四个macOS任务的七个模型配置:工作手册推理,PDF格式填充,饮食受限制的购物研究和酒店比较,每个任务和模型最多有3个记录运行. 表5总结了五个配置,报告所有四项任务的平均互动费用,包括不完整的任务。 步骤计数模型响应,输出符号包括所记录的推理. 美元成本是根据记录的答复使用量、缓存点击量和公共API价格估算的。

blocks.en: Execution Efficiency. Generation volume differs more sharply than interaction length. GPT-6 Astra averages 34.5 steps and 12.9K output tokens per task, compared with 50.8 steps and 73.4K tokens for Qwen3.8-Max: 1.5 times as many steps and 5.7 times as many output tokens . Much of this difference lies in reported reasoning, which averages 2.6K tokens for GPT and 50.2K for Qwen. Claude Opus 5 and Gemini 3.8 Flash use 42.3K and 31.9K output tokens per task, respectively. Token usage and monetary cost need not rank models in the same order: under the archived pricing assumptions, Qwen3.8-Max costs $1.49 per task, compared with $18.29 for GPT-6 Astra.
blocks.zh: 执行效率。 相较于交互长度,生成体积差异更大. GPT-6 Astra平均每个任务34.5个步和12.9K个出产令牌,而Qune3.8-Max的50.8个步和73.4K个出产令牌:是出产令牌的1.5倍和5.7倍. 这一差异主要在于报告的推理,平均为GPT的2.6K令牌和Quen的50.2K. Claude Opus 5和双子座 3.8 Flash分别使用每个任务的42.3K和31.9K输出符. 托肯用法和货币成本不需要按同一顺序排列模型:在存档的定价假设下,Quen3.8-Max每任务成本为1.49美元,而GPT-6 Astra为18.29美元.

blocks.en: On the workbook task, both selected runs satisfy the evaluation criteria, but GPT-6 Astra uses 22 steps and 8,783 output tokens, compared with 37 steps and 120,831 tokens for Qwen3.8-Max. Reported reasoning accounts for 1,487 and 92,974 tokens, respectively. On the PDF task, Qwen also uses significantly more output tokens (28,268 versus 10,013). The following case studies examine how observation choices and code execution contribute to the observed differences. With only four tasks and one run per model, these results characterize the evaluated configurations rather than establish a general model ranking.
blocks.zh: 在工作簿任务上,被选中的两个运行都符合评价标准,但GPT-6 Astra使用22个步骤和8,783个输出令牌,而Qune3.8-Max则使用37个步骤和120,831个令牌. 报告的推理分别占了1,487个和92,974个令牌. 在PDF任务上,Quen也使用显著多的输出符(28,268对10,013). 以下案例研究研究观察选择和代码执行如何促进观察到的差异. 由于每个模型只有4个任务和1个运行,这些结果成为了所评价的配置的特征,而不是建立一般模型排名.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Reasoning cost and observation-target selection. GPT-6 Astra captures the selected Amazon page, while Qwen3.8-Max captures the foreground Taobao page and then switches to Amazon. Qwen3.8-Max uses substantially more reasoning tokens.
blocks.zh: 图10:合理成本和观察目标选择。 GPT-6 Astra抓取了所选的亚马逊页面,而Quen3.8-Max抓取了前台道宝页面,再切换到亚马逊. Qune3.8-Max使用大量推理符.

blocks.en: 4.3.4 Case Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3.4 案例研究

blocks.en: The gap in real-device execution extends from basic operation to completing an entire task. We compare GPT-6 Astra and Qwen3.8-Max through earlier low-effort trajectories under the same harness on real-device tasks, separate from the selected runs in Table 5 . The following cases show differences in the cost of routine operations, the selection of observation targets, and the ability to turn a task into an effective program.
blocks.zh: 实际设备执行的差距从基本操作到完成整个任务。 我们比较GPT-6 Astra 和 Quen3.8-Max 通过早期的低功率轨迹, 在同一套带下, 与表5中选定的运行相分离。 以下案例显示常规操作的成本,观测目标的选择,以及将任务转化为有效程序的能力等不同.

blocks.en: Large Differences in Reasoning Cost for Simple Operations. In a shopping task, Qwen produces a four-line program that captures and returns a desktop screenshot. The program returns an image, but the model response uses 2,105 output tokens, including 2,030 reasoning tokens. GPT also obtains a screenshot in another step of the same task, but its entire response uses only 124 output tokens, including 11 reasoning tokens (Figure 10 ). This contrast shows that a substantial reasoning-cost gap can arise even in a simple observation step. Such generation overhead can introduce substantial execution latency.
blocks.zh: 简单业务原因成本差异很大。 在购物任务中,Quen生产出能捕捉并返回桌面截图的四行程序. 程序返回了一幅图像,但模型响应使用2,105个输出符,包括2,030个推理符. GPT也在同一项任务的又一步骤中获得截图,但其整个响应只使用124个输出符,包括11个推理符(图10. 这种对比表明,即使是在简单的观察步骤中,也可能出现重大的推理成本差距。 这种代用间接费用可带来大量执行延迟。

blocks.en: Difficulty Adapting to Real-Device Conditions. On a real device, the page an agent needs to inspect may not be in the foreground. In the shopping task, Qwen is working with an Amazon browser object but requests a desktop screenshot, which shows the foreground Taobao login page. It then brings Amazon forward and captures again. GPT instead requests a screenshot directly from its selected browser page. Both models use screenshots; the contrast concerns observation scope, illustrating why the intended task target cannot be assumed to coincide with the foreground interface.
blocks.zh: 难以适应 Real-Device 条件 。 在真实设备上,代理人需要检查的页面可能不在前台. 在购物任务中,Quen正与一个亚马逊浏览器对象合作,但请求桌面截图,显示前台道宝登录页面. 然后它又将亚马逊带往前并再次捕捉. GPT则直接从其所选浏览器页面中请求截图. 这两个模型都使用截图;对比点涉及观测范围,说明了为何不能假定预定的任务目标与前方接口相吻合.

blocks.en: A Gap in Task-Level Code Execution. A workbook task reveals a difference in how models translate task requirements into programs. GPT-6 Astra builds a reusable solver, checks it against seven supplied examples, and identifies question rows from the workbook contents. Its program generates answers for all 125 questions. Qwen3.8-Max also uses functions and loops, but processes fixed row ranges that cover only 85 questions. Although its program reports this count, Qwen3.8-Max does not check for omitted questions. An audit of the saved workbooks confirms that GPT fills all 125 required Level answer cells, while Qwen3.8-Max leaves 40 empty (Figure 11 ). The gap is therefore not simply whether a model can write executable code with loops and conditions, but whether it can use code correctly to cover the full task and check for incomplete work.
blocks.zh: 任务级别代码执行中的漏洞 。 一个工作手册任务揭示了模型如何将任务要求转化为程序的不同. GPT-6 Astra 构建了可重复使用的解析器,对照7个提供的例子来检查,并从工作簿内容中识别出问题行. 它的程序生成所有125个问题的答案. Qune3.8-Max也使用函数和回路,但处理仅能覆盖85个问题的固定行范围. 尽管它的程序报告了这个计数,但Qune3.8-Max并没有检查省略的问题. 对所保存的工作簿的审计证实,GPT填充了所有需要的125个关卡解答单元格,而Qune3.8-Max留下了40个空格(图11. 因此,差距不仅仅是一个模型能否用循环和条件来写出可执行代码,而是它是否能够正确使用代码来覆盖全部任务并检查不完整的工作.

blocks.en: Figure 11: Task coverage in code execution. GPT-6 Astra fills all 125 required Level answer cells, while Qwen3.8-Max leaves 40 empty.
blocks.zh: 图11:代码执行中的任务覆盖范围. GPT-6 Astra 填补所有125个需要的关卡解答单元格,而Qune3.8-Max则留下了40个空格.

blocks.en: 5 Roadmap
blocks.zh: 5 路线图

blocks.en: Open Generalist CUA aims to make generalist computer use a shared research effort in which models, execution systems, and real-device evaluation advance together. This first release provides an initial basis for that work.
blocks.zh: 开放通论(Open Generalist CUA)旨在让通论计算机使用共同的研究工作,其中模型,执行系统,和真设备评价一起推进. 第一次发布为这项工作提供了初步依据。

blocks.en: 5.1 From Design Validation to Model Release
blocks.zh: 5.1 从设计验证到模型发布

blocks.en: The model-side contribution of this report is empirical validation of agent design using existing models , rather than a newly trained model. We study code execution and harness-to-model decision transfer, and release implementations, prompts, and evaluation trajectories alongside preliminary versions of the real-device harness and cross-device SDK.
blocks.zh: 本报告的模型侧面贡献是利用现有模型对代理设计进行经验验证,而不是新培训的模型。 我们研究代码执行和对模式化决策的转移, 释放执行, 提示,和评价轨迹 与初步版本的真设备 和交叉设备SDK。

blocks.en: A GCUA model is the central addition planned for the next release. We aim to unify computer and browser use and turn the designs studied here into learned capabilities: coordinating visual and programmatic operations through code, requesting observations when needed, maintaining task state throughout execution, and particularly enhancing the capability in real-device scenario.
blocks.zh: 一个GCUA模型是计划下一期的中央添加. 我们的目标是统一计算机和浏览器的使用,将这里研究的设计转化为学到的能力:通过代码协调视觉和程序操作,在需要时请求观察,在整个执行过程中保持任务状态,并特别增强真设备情景中的能力.

blocks.en: 5.2 Research Priorities
blocks.zh: 5.2 研究优先事项

blocks.en: More Efficient Reasoning and Execution. We will optimize the model’s thinking, making reasoning more concise for routine operations and mitigating overthinking. On the harness and infrastructure side, we will improve code execution, context management, and infrastructure optimization. We will also explore new system architectures and other system-level solutions for efficiency.
blocks.zh: 更有效率的理由和执行。 我们将优化模型的思维,使推理在常规操作中更加简洁,并减轻过度思考。 在利用和基础设施方面,我们将改进代码执行、上下文管理和基础设施优化。 我们还将探索新的系统架构和其他系统层面提高效率的解决方案。

blocks.en: Reliable Work on Users’ Devices. We plan to extend the harness and SDK toward tasks spanning computers, browsers, and potentially mobile devices. Priorities include reliable target selection, recovery from execution failures, and task continuity when users interrupt or change their requests. We will also investigate which additional workflow decisions should move from fixed harness rules to the model.
blocks.zh: 用户设备的可靠工作。 我们计划把牵引和SDK 扩展为跨越计算机、浏览器和潜在移动设备的任务。 优先事项包括可靠的目标选择,从执行失败中恢复,以及当用户中断或更改请求时任务连续性. 我们还将调查哪些工作流程决定应从固定规则转向模式。

blocks.en: Real-Device Environments and Benchmarks. We will develop evaluation environments and benchmarks on real devices, particularly macOS, covering a wider range of applications, user interactions, and changing device states. The goal is to measure whether agents complete useful work under real operating conditions, together with the time and resources required.
blocks.zh: 真实环境与基准。 我们将开发关于真实设备的评价环境和基准,特别是macOS,涵盖更广泛的应用程序、用户互动和不断变化的设备状态。 目标是衡量代理人在实际操作条件下是否完成了有益的工作,以及所需的时间和资源。

blocks.en: 5.3 How to Contribute
blocks.zh: 5.3 如何作出贡献

blocks.en: We welcome contributions to both the implementation and the research agenda: • Improve the Harness and SDK. Contribute platform adapters, more reliable observation and control, execution optimizations, or real-device testing and documentation. • Build Real-Device Evaluation. Contribute environments, realistic tasks, evaluation criteria, and benchmark infrastructure, including execution traces that expose current limitations. • Propose Research Goals. Identify workflows agents should support, capabilities worth developing, or questions to investigate through the released systems and trajectories. These priorities guide planned releases without fixing a delivery timeline. The agenda will evolve with experimental evidence and community proposals, including directions beyond those listed here. Our goal is for the community to help shape not only how GCUAs are built, but also what they should be able to do and how progress should be measured.
blocks.zh: 我们欢迎对执行和研究议程的贡献:改进 " 和谐 " 和 " SDK " 。 提供平台适配器,更可靠的观测和控制,执行优化,或真设备测试和文件. • 建立真正的评价。 贡献环境、现实的任务、评价标准和基准基础设施,包括暴露目前局限性的执行痕迹。 • 提出研究目标。 确定工作流程代理人应提供支持,建立值得发展的能力,或通过发布系统和轨迹进行调查的问题。 这些优先事项指导计划的发布,但没有确定交付时间表。 议程将随着实验证据和社区建议而演变,包括此处所列方向以外的方向。 我们的目标是让社区不仅帮助塑造全球海关责任协定的建立方式,而且帮助塑造它们应当能够做些什么以及如何衡量进展。

blocks.en: Improve the Harness and SDK. Contribute platform adapters, more reliable observation and control, execution optimizations, or real-device testing and documentation.
blocks.zh: 改进机能和SDK 提供平台适配器,更可靠的观测和控制,执行优化,或真设备测试和文档.

blocks.en: Build Real-Device Evaluation. Contribute environments, realistic tasks, evaluation criteria, and benchmark infrastructure, including execution traces that expose current limitations.
blocks.zh: 构建Real-Device评价. 贡献环境、现实的任务、评价标准和基准基础设施,包括暴露目前局限性的执行痕迹。

blocks.en: Propose Research Goals. Identify workflows agents should support, capabilities worth developing, or questions to investigate through the released systems and trajectories.
blocks.zh: 建议研究 目标。 确定工作流程代理人应提供支持,建立值得发展的能力,或通过发布系统和轨迹进行调查的问题。

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Frontier Computer Use. OpenAI positions GPT-6 Astra for difficult end-to-end work and describes computer use as a new frontier in speed, accuracy, and safety. It recommends code execution for computer-use tasks while retaining the structured computer tool as an alternative ( OpenAI, 2026c ; OpenAI, 2026b ) . In Codex, Computer Use can see and operate graphical user interfaces on macOS and Windows, support workflows spanning multiple applications, and, on macOS, run scoped background tasks while the user continues working elsewhere ( OpenAI, 2026a ) . Anthropic also provides computer use in Claude Cowork and Claude Code: Claude first reaches for the most precise tool, such as connectors to services like Slack or Google Calendar, and can directly control the browser, mouse, keyboard, and screen when no connector is available. Its Dispatch feature further lets users assign tasks from a phone and open the completed work on a computer ( Anthropic, 2026b ) . Despite these capabilities, the public releases leave key implementation details and execution trajectories unavailable, making their system designs difficult for the community to reproduce and study systematically.
blocks.zh: 边疆计算机使用(Frontier Computer Use. OpenAI sets GPT-6 Astra)为困难的端到端工作,并描述计算机在速度,准确性和安全性上作为一个新的前沿使用. 它建议计算机使用任务的代码执行,同时保留结构化的计算机工具作为替代品(OpenAI, 2026c;OpenAI, 2026b). In Codex, Computer 使用可以在macOS和Windows上看到并操作图形用户界面,支持跨多应用程序的工作流程,在macOS上,在用户继续到他处工作的同时运行有范围的背景任务(OpenAI,2026a). Anthropic还提供克洛德Cowork和克洛德代码中的计算机使用: Claude首先到达最精确的工具,例如连接器到Slack或Google Calendar等服务,并且在没有连接器时可以直接控制浏览器,鼠标,键盘和屏幕. 它的调度功能还允许用户从电话中分配任务,并在计算机上打开已完成的工作(Anthropic, 2026b.). 尽管具备这些能力,但公开发布会留下关键实施细节和执行轨迹,使社区难以系统地复制和研究其系统设计。

blocks.en: Computer-Use Agents. Prior open CUA models remain largely GUI-centric. UI-TARS and UI-TARS-2 ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , OpenCUA ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , ScaleCUA ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , EvoCUA ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , and Fara ( Microsoft, 2026 ) release open models for computer use and report strong results on relevant benchmarks. Recent work has begun to explore hybrid GUI–programmatic execution: CoAct-1, ComputerRL, UltraCUA, ToolCUA, and StateAct combine GUI control with code, APIs, tool calls, or program-state operations ( Song et al., 2026 ; Lai et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) ; RecreationWorld and WeaveBench respectively provide environments and benchmarks for such interleaved trajectories ( Bai et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Our previous work, Qwen-UI-Agent, introduced a unified GUI–CLI action space with batched actions, a real-device mobile runtime, and a harness for proactive cross-platform execution ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) . To capture this broader setting, following the system-level perspective of Agents’ Last Exam ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , we use the term Generalist Computer-Use Agent (GCUA). We define a GCUA as an agent system that completes diverse computer tasks through visual interaction and programmatic access, choosing how to observe, act, and organize its work as each task requires .
blocks.zh: 电脑用户 以前的开放的CUA模型基本上仍然是以GUI为中心的. UI-TARS和UI-TARS-2(秦等,2025;王等,2025a),OpenCUA(王等,2025b),ScaleCUA (刘等,2025年),"EvoCUA"(黄等,2026年),"法拉"(微软,2026年)发布开放模型供计算机使用,并报告相关基准的有力结果. 最近的工作已经开始探索混合图形用户界面-程序执行:CoAct-1, ComputerRL, UltraCUA, ToolCUA, 和 State Act将图形用户界面控制与代码, API, 工具调用, 或程序状态操作相结合(Song等, 2026; Lai等, 2025; Yang等, 2026b; Hu等, 2026a; Yang等, 2026a) ; RecentingWorld和Weave Bench 分别为这种互放轨道提供了环境和基准(Bai等, 2026; Li等, 2026). 我们之前的作品"Quen-UI-Agent"引入了一个统一的GUI-CLI动作空间,包含分批动作,实时设备移动运行时间,以及主动跨平台执行的杠杆(周等,2026;周等,2025). 为了抓住这一更广泛的背景,遵循 " 代理人 " 系统层面的观点 Last Exam (Sun等, 2026),我们使用通用计算机使用代理(GCUA)一词. 我们把GCUA定义为一个代理系统,它通过视觉交互和程序访问来完成各种计算机任务,选择如何观察、采取行动和按照每项任务的要求安排其工作。

blocks.en: Open Computer-Use Infrastructure. Several projects provide open harnesses for computer-use agents. The cua project provides cross-platform desktop drivers and sandbox SDKs ( trycua, 2026 ) . The Agent S series provides open orchestration frameworks with memory, visual grounding, and increasingly code-based execution ( Agashe et al., 2025a ; Agashe et al., 2025b ; Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2026 ) . Open Computer Use provides an MCP-wrapped desktop-control runtime, including macOS control through Accessibility ( iFurySt, 2026 ) . These are complementary to our work. Open Generalist CUA is an ongoing project to open a full GCUA research stack that couples a trained model with a real-device harness, a cross-device SDK, and execution trajectories.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented the first release of Open Generalist CUA, an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for generalist computer use. Our GCUA formulation centers on three model decisions: what to observe, how to act, and how to organize work. Code execution lets models use intermediate results to coordinate GUI and programmatic operations and apply their existing programming capabilities to computer interaction. Harness-to-model decision transfer complements this design by moving selected observation and task-state decisions from fixed harness rules to the model. On the offline subset of OSWorld-v2, the full OpenGCUA configuration improves task scores across all eight evaluated models, raising mean partial score by 19.6 points and reducing reported steps per task by an average of 53.0% relative to batched GUI-only execution. Ablations show additional benefits from code execution with the same GUI and CLI access, indicating that execution design matters beyond interface access.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了开放通论CUA的首次发布,这是一个正在进行的开发和打开通论计算机使用的完整堆栈的项目. 我们的GCUA的制定以三项示范决定为中心:观察什么,如何行动,如何组织工作。 代码执行允许模型使用中间结果来协调GUI与程序操作,并将其现有的编程能力应用于计算机交互. 通过将选定的观察和任务状态决定从固定的取用规则移到模型中来补充这种设计。 在OSWorld-v2的离线子集上,完整的OpenGCUA配置改进了所有8个被评价模型的任务分数,将平均部分分数提高了19.6分并比批量的GUI只执行平均减少53.0%. 使用相同的GUI和CLI访问显示代码执行的额外好处,表明执行设计事项超出接口访问范围.

blocks.en: We release our implementation, prompts, and evaluation trajectories, alongside preliminary versions of a real-device harness and cross-device SDK. Evaluations on four macOS tasks reveal substantial differences in reported reasoning-token usage and task completion under the same harness. This report studies GCUA designs rather than introducing a newly trained model. OpenGCUA will continue through further research and releases on GCUA models, reasoning and execution efficiency, and real-device environments and benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们发布了我们的执行, 提示,和评估轨迹, 与初步版本的 真正的设备控制器和交叉设备SDK。 对4个macOS任务的评价表明,在报告的推理式使用和在同一工具下完成任务方面存在很大差异。 本报告研究GCUA的设计,而不是采用新培训的模式。 OpenGCUA将通过进一步研究和发布GCUA模型,推理和执行效率,以及真设备环境和基准,继续.

blocks.en: Metrics and Aggregation. We evaluate the 82-task offline subset of OSWorld-v2 v2.1. Task score is the mean evaluator partial score, expressed on a 0–100 scale. Full-task success is the percentage of tasks with a normalized evaluator score greater than 0.999999. Steps and token counts are averaged over all selected tasks, including failures. Within each run, we retain the latest attempt with an evaluator result for each task, not the highest-scoring attempt. Cross-model summaries give each model equal weight: score gains are averaged in points, and relative resource reductions are calculated within each model before averaging.
